Classical computer which we use in our daily lives are probabilistic, deterministic and logical. These devices help us tackle many tasks such as education, medical issues, banking and many others. As the data increases in our world the shortage of storage capacity and computation of such a massive data is increasing day by day. We therefore need a new device that can deal with the problem and deliver outcomes that are satisfactory. Quantum Computers are a new, forthcoming technology that can help with these challenges. These computers can store and process information that a classical computer cannot, by using entangled quantum bits (qubits). The power of computation and storage grows exponentially as qubit entanglement rises. This could introduce us to a new realm of powerful computation and alter how we handle huge datasets.

articleTitle: Vita Health – A Complete Healthcare System
abstract: Good health has been a major concern since the inception of mankind although for some people attaining good health requires taking prescribed medicines or pills routinely. However, many patients find it very difficult to keep track of taking their medication at the right time and proportion. This happens due to several reasons such as heavy workload, forgetfulness, old age, busy schedule, and many more. Some people undergo multiple medications in a day and it can be quite confusing for them to take appropriate medication at the correct and appropriate time as directed.The solution to the problem is to create a Speech based medicine intake tracker and Healthcare assistant named Vita Health. The proposed ideology serves the patients about their medicine dosage quantity and time in the form of voice notes that read aloud the name of the medicine. This app scans the medicine package and prescription then checks the expiry and reminds on the date on which it is expired. Predicting accurate medicine through printed prescriptions can be a real challenge in this solution. Our main aim is to deeply research about approaches to overcome this challenge. Some of them are OCR (Optical Character Recognition), NLP(Natural Language Processing), and CNN(Convolutional Neural Networks). There is a field to include the starting and ending dates and time slots within which the medicine is to be taken. There is a list of contacts of doctors near you where you can chat and contact them. In case the patient forgets or skips to take the medicines, a reminder is sent to the doctor and to nearby ones to keep a track and remind them to take the medicine.

articleTitle: PV FED Cascaded Multilevel Boost Converter with Multilevel Inverter Using MPPT
abstract: In recent years, solar energy has become more prevalent. In a result of this, many countries are establishing solar power-producing plants. Establishing an experimental installation for a photovoltaic (PV)-based power system with a cascaded multilevel boost DC-DC converter with a multilevel H-Bridge inverter circuit is recommended as a way to test the system’s ability to function. This paper presents a solar PV-fed Cascaded multilevel boost converter with a multilevel inverter. A PV module, a Cascaded multilevel boost converter, and a multilevel inverter comprise the proposed methodology. The Cascaded multilevel boost converter boosts the voltage of the PV module by connecting two boost converters in series. The Cascaded multilevel boost converter’s DC output is converted into an AC output by multilevel inverter. The proposed methodology can produce an output waveform of high quality with far less THD and greater efficiency. MATLAB/Simulink software is utilized to design and simulate the system, and the simulated results indicate how effective the proposed methodology is. Renewable energy systems such solar PV systems, wind energy systems, and hybrid energy systems were expected to be potential applications for the proposed system. Simulation results are conveyed through MATLAB/Simulink domain and the working of the suggested converter is realized.

articleTitle: Techno-Economic Feasibility Analysis of Solar Wind-Based Hybrid Power System on the Islands of the Northern Bay of Bengal
abstract: The ever-rising energy demand has pushed the world from conventional fossil fuel-based power generation systems to more sustainable renewable energy-based power generation systems. Renewable energy-based power systems can be more efficacious than conventional systems in certain locations considering the geological and socioeconomic aspects. Solar wind-based hybrid power systems can be a substantial aid for supplying uninterrupted power to distant islands where transmission lines are unable to reach from the mainland. The concern of this research work is to analyze the feasibility of solar wind-based hybrid systems on the islands of the Northern Bay of Bengal. Seven islands of the Northern Bay of Bengal were picked out based on their size, the volume of population, existing power generation system and socioeconomic conditions. A solar wind-based hybrid power system has been proposed for a community of 5 thousand families on the selected islands that is capable of supplying an average load of 26643 kWh/day and meeting up an annual peak of 2795 kW. The Net Present Cost (NPC), Cost of Energy (COE) and other parameters have been analyzed to figure out the most feasible island. Sandwip is proven to be techno-economically the most feasible island in the Northern Bay of Bengal with an impressive Optimized Cost of Energy (OCOE) of 0.212 USD only.

articleTitle: Automatic Music Labeling Algorithm based on Tag Depth Analysis
abstract: With the rapid development of music social media, online music resources are rapidly increasing and music types are increasingly diversified. As an effective means to organize massive music data, rich music annotation information has become an important part of online music services. Automatic music tagging algorithm based on tag depth analysis is an automatic music tagging method that uses the concept of tag depth to classify songs. The algorithm starts with a set of songs, where each song is assigned one or more tags. The lengths of these markers are then compared and assigned to different categories. For example, if a song has three tags, it will be classified as pop / rock, dance and country music. If the song uses two tags, it will be classified as rock / pop and pop / rock, respectively. This process will continue until all songs have been classified by their tag depth and classified accordingly.

articleTitle: Handwritten Equations Solver Using Convolution Neural Network
abstract: Mathematics is fundamental to everyone’s existence. We typically use calculators embedded into our current devices to solve mathematical equations. This project aims to develop a Handwritten Equation Solver that can solve mathematical equations written by a wide range of people. A neural network approach is used to recognize symbols and alphabets. Among other things, the system can recognize alphabets, all integers, mathematical symbols, and some special symbols. When one or more variables’ coefficients are multiplied by their sum of powers, the result is an algebraic expression known as a polynomial. If x is variable, ax+b=0 then it is linear polynomial equation. We show how computers can learn cognitive skills that allow them to understand an issue based on its visual context. The problem is simplified by using an image of handwritten polynomial equations as input and producing the answer as output. The proposed workflow method automatically simplifies the Handwritten polynomial equation. Horizontal compact projection analysis and combination linked component analysis approaches are used for segmentation. To classify individual characters, a Convolution Neural Network is utilized. For the solution of the problem, a character string operation is used for each proper detection. It’s also quite good at what it does. For the solution of the equation, each proper detection, character string operation is employed. Finally, the experimental findings reveal that our proposed approach is really effective.

articleTitle: Detection of Pneumonia from Chest X-Ray Images Using Transfer Learning on Deep CNN
abstract: Pneumonia is a serious lung infection that can be life-threatening if not diagnosed and treated on time. Accurately diagnosing pneumonia from X-ray images is essential for timely treatment and improved patient outcomes. In this research paper, we propose an approach for diagnosing pneumonia using X-ray images by leveraging the power of convolutional neural networks (CNNs) and transfer learning. The proposed approach utilizes a pre-trained MobileNet model, which is a popular CNN architecture, and adds additional layers on top to fine-tune the model for the specific task of diagnosing pneumonia. This approach was more effective than training a CNN model from scratch or using traditional machine-learning methods. Our proposed approach demonstrated superior performance when compared to previously utilized models and techniques as evidenced by the results obtained. The use of CNNs and transfer learning in medical imaging is a growing area of research, and our proposed approach is a significant advancement in the field of pneumonia diagnosis. The proposed approach has the potential to improve the accuracy and efficiency of pneumonia diagnosis and ultimately save lives.

articleTitle: Leveraging Performance of Over-the-Top Media Platforms using Blockchain Technology
abstract: Blockchain is ideal for transferring data because it provides rapid, shareable, and completely simple data that is recorded on a permanent record that is essentially gathered by organized and permission businesses. A developing e-commerce paradigm in recent years is using OTT (over-the-top) platforms to deliver digital media content. Blockchain promises to improve the security and usability of the OTT industry. But as the industry has expanded, more difficulties have emerged, such as copyright violations and the unauthorized dissemination of protected information. Blockchain technology has the ability to end the long-standing troubles that the media and OTT industries have. Leaders in the media and broadcasting industries are also hopeful that blockchain-based media solutions will help them overcome their difficulties in monetizing their material. This paper highlights the importance of Blockchain in the OTT industry, such as decentralized content distribution models, accessibility and ownership, media royalty payments, etc., and the challenges faced. It also emphasizes the different components of Blockchain-based video streaming platforms.

articleTitle: Implementation of Covid patient Health Monitoring System using IoT
abstract: During COVID outbreaks, we have special Covid 19 Quarantine centers built to care for Covid individuals. Isolating Covid patients is essential due to the disease's high contagiousness, however, surgeons must also keep an eye on the well-being of Covid patients. Given the increase in occurrences, keeping track of the health complications of numerous isolated individuals is getting challenging. Physicians must frequently check patient health; with a growing variety of patients to examine, clinicians are at danger of infection just for monitoring purposes. The suggested method enables the internet-based wireless connectivity of several Covid individuals. This device is intended to track the warmth, respiratory rate, and Blood oxygen saturation levels of the patient as well as assess the disease intensity by listening to the individual cough. The created system is connected to an internet connection and uses Wi-Fi to communicate data about measured parameters over the web. The Firebase cloud platform receives the transmitted data via IOT and displays it remotely. A circuitry built on an Arduino platform regulates the whole system.

articleTitle: Design and Analyzing of DC Transformer Efficiency Enhancement for Microgrid Applications
abstract: Our projects deal with the step-down chopper (or) buck converter and its operation. Because of using transformer circuit, we can see less output and losses are going to produce while using the transformer circuit. When we use transformer, we are going to observe many losses because of that we are going to see the output less in the circuit, and to get efficient power at the output side we are using chopper. We give in the input side a fixed supply (Vs) and the output side we are going to see a variable dc output (Vout). The output which we are going to get increased dc voltage or decreased dc voltage because the type which we are using in the circuit. By using the step-up chopper, the output (Vout) will be more than the supply voltage (Vs), if we use step-down chopper the output voltage (Vout) will be less than the supply voltage (Vs), if we use a buck/boost chopper we can perform the both operations (step-up step-down) at a time. Because of using a chopper instead of transformer in the circuit we get more voltage than which we get in the transformer. In chopper circuit we may not observe losses. In this project we are going to modelling the equations for the new circuit according to the conditions which we are having for the chopper.

articleTitle: 2Q-Learning Scheme for Resume Screening
abstract: Resume screening is a tedious process as it involves a lot of challenges in terms of handling a voluminous number of resumes, performing screening operations, extracting precisely suitable competent profiles out of all available profiles, and so on. In literature several techniques are available for resume screening which include manual inspection, resume parsing, and many more. These techniques produce inconsistent results and consume a lot of time of recruiters as all the techniques lack automation and learning capabilities. This paper uses a 2Q-Learning-based approach enriched with natural language processing capability to accurately evaluate resumes. Additionally, by offering advice on potential resume improvements, it helps to enrich the candidate’s resume. It also eliminates the unconscious prejudice and human errors that occur throughout the traditional recruitment procedure. Overall, it is advantageous for both job seekers and recruiters in terms of learning rate, scalability, and accuracy. Overall, it is advantageous for both job seekers and recruiters.

articleTitle: Research on Basic Network Protocol of Basic BP Neural Network
abstract: This study aims to explore the basic network protocol research based on BP neural networks. BP neural network is a feedforward network composed of multiple layers of neurons, with learning and generalization abilities. The basic network protocol research based on BP neural network can be used for the design of transmission and routing protocols in various computer networks. Firstly, this study introduces the BP neural network and its training algorithm, including the basic structure and working principle of neurons, Backpropagation and weight update formula. Then, the feasibility and advantages of applying BP neural network to basic network protocol design were explored. BP neural network can learn and adapt to the network environment independently, and optimize the network performance by adjusting the network weight and Activation function and other parameters. Subsequently, this study proposes a transmission protocol design method and a routing protocol design method based on BP neural networks. The design method of transmission protocol focuses on how to select appropriate network parameters and training samples for model training, in order to construct a high-performance transmission protocol. The routing protocol design method focuses on how to use the network topology information and Routing table information in the neural network to build a reliable and efficient network routing protocol. In addition to these three layers, there is a Activation function between I and o. The Activation function can be used to calculate a value indicating the degree to which each node in o is activated by I input. It aims to learn and operate in environments with limited resources, such as on-board computers or mobile devices. The main advantage of this network is that it can reduce the number of parameters to be trained by using only two input variables and one output variable. This makes it easy for users to implement and use on their own systems without any special knowledge of neural networks or machine learning algorithms.In summary, this study explores the study of basic network protocols based on BP neural networks. This method can fully utilize the learning and adaptability of neural networks, achieve autonomous learning and optimization of network protocols, improve the performance and reliability of the network, and has important theoretical value and practical application significance.

articleTitle: Double-Frequency Multilevel Boost Converter
abstract: This study suggests a (MBC) multi level boost converter with a doubling frequency. The DC-DC multilevel boost converter uses two driven switches, two inductors, two 2X-1 diodes, and a 2X-1 capacitor for a XN DFMBC. It is a PWM (Pulse Width Modulation) based converter that also accomplishes boost conversion and switched capacitor function to provide various output voltages and self equalized voltage. Power electronics is concerned with the DC-DC converter's efficiency, static and dynamic properties. This converter includes two boost cells, each of which functions at a high frequency rate and the another at a low frequency rate. Normal step up converters cannot retain high gain under high voltage stress, and low frequency converters have low efficiency. High frequency converters are also less efficient due to poor performance. As a result of using DF multilevel converter it, enhance performance, efficiency, gain with different output voltage level. MATLAB/Simulink is used to model the suggested converter.

articleTitle: HLS Based Design and Optimization of Merge Sort Algorithm for High Performance Computing
abstract: High level synthesis has emerged as a powerful tool for designing hardware algorithms for high performance computing systems. In this paper, we present an HLS based design and optimization of the merge sort algorithm for HPC applications. We use Xilinx’s Vivado HLS tool to generate hardware description language code from C based descriptions of the algorithm, and then optimize the code for throughput and latency using HLS directives. Our results demonstrate that the optimized merge sort algorithm provides a significant improvement in performance over traditional software-based implementations. Our work contributes to the growing body of research on using HLS for HPC applications. The proposed HLS based design and optimized merge sort algorithm shows the results like area usage, latency, efficiency, throughput in comparison with unoptimized merge sort.

articleTitle: Analyzing Robustness and Accuracy of Different Controllers for Underactuated Ships
abstract: Most ships that carry cargo from one place to another are underactuated. Therefore, controlling such vessels is challenging, and even a few major accidents in the industry can be attributed to ineffective control by a human operator. Automated control can significantly aid in the prevention of such incidents. This paper demonstrates the practical implementation of a path-following algorithm for an underactuated scaled model of a container ship. In this research, two different control strategies have been compared against each other: Proportional Derivative Control (PD) and Sliding Mode Control (SMC). The underactuated vessel is made to track a given set of waypoints, and the performance of the controllers is measured. For this study, a 1:75.5 scaled free-running model of the KRISO Container Ship (KCS) is chosen as the test ship. Simulations were done using a numerical model of the vessel’s dynamics and the controllers are compared for their accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Network Database based on Big Data
abstract: With the advent of network informatization, the amount of information generated in social production and life surged, and database technology developed rapidly. In the process of the rapid development of database related technology, how to store more data and ensure the security of data information storage has become the focus of research. The construction of network database based on big data is a process of analyzing and extracting information from a large amount of data, which can be used to analyze the structure and function of the network. The main purpose is to study the relationship between nodes in the network, such as how many nodes are connected to each other, and what relationship exists between them, so as to better understand the characteristics and behavior of the network. Social network refers to an online platform created for people who want to communicate with each other through text messages or voice calls. Social media platforms have become very popular.

articleTitle: Real-time Yoga Pose Classification and Correction: YogaAI
abstract: People have acknowledged the importance of health care since the Pandemic. One of the best methods for developing a healthy lifestyle is yoga. Posture is the most important aspect of yoga practice. The user of the existing yoga position detectors was required to gaze at the screen at all times because they did not offer audible feedback. Additionally, there are currently no tools that offer detailed instructions for performing yoga. Given this, the proposed system, YogaAI seeks to use computer vision technology to overcome the shortcomings of current solutions and offer efficient and successful ones. By offering tailored yoga instructions based on the user's health status, our project aspires to serve as a self-assisted healthcare companion for the user. Real-time pose identification and classification for yoga would be possible. The system will also provide a step-by-step tutorial for the posture, feedback (visual, auditory), a counter, and a duration tracker for the particular pose.

articleTitle: Simulation and Analysis of a MEMS based Micromirror System for Deployment in Optical Beam Steering Systems Used in Experimental Quantum Computing
abstract: The aim of this study is to highlight the utility and applicability of Microelectromechanical systems (MEMS) technology in addressing the existing challenges of precision control of beams in performing manipulation of two-dimensional atomic systems or states of a qubit in Quantum Optics setups. This study specifically focuses on the utility of a controllable MEMS based Micromirror that maneuvers a laser source to access multiple positions of a qubit in a two-dimensional trapped lattice; an application of pertinent interest to Experimental Quantum Computation. This paper focuses on simulating a MEMS based micromirror system proposed by (Knoernschild et al. [1]) in COMSOL and analyzing its architecture.

articleTitle: Investigation of Switched Capacitor Multi Level Inverter Topology for Different Voltage Levels
abstract: This paper focuses on the switched-capacitor converter configurations for wide ranges of applications, which have numerous stages which are designed for different voltage levels. A single-phase multilevel boost inverter topology configuration with fifteen levels and nineteen levels are discussed with same switching circuit. The capacitors are connected in series-parallel configuration to generate an output voltage more than input voltage. The same topology can be used for dual conversion configurations like DC-DC and DC-AC by adding a ground terminal at load point.

articleTitle: Cost Control System of Power Grid Project Based on Digital Orientation
abstract: The cost control system of power grid project based on digital direction is studied. The main purpose of this study is to understand the impact of digitalization on reducing total cost and improving service quality. Another objective is to determine the impact of digitization on various parameters, such as operating expenses, investment, maintenance, operation and maintenance costs,etc. This will help to make a decision on BHEL’s future investment strategy. The study was completed by using various tools (such as simulation, analysis and modeling)to find the best way to reduce the cost of the grid. It also includes an assessment of factors that will help reduce costs, such as distribution networks, generation capacity, transmission lines and other related factors.

articleTitle: Low Profile Miniaturized Wideband Antenna For mmW Applications
abstract: This research work aims to design a Microstrip Patch Antenna(MPA) with improved bandwidth for millimeter wave (mmW) applications. Due to its low dielectric loss, a relatively thin Rogers RT/Duroid 6002, with a dielectric constant of 2.94 and a height of 0.76 mm, is used as the substrate. To further enhance the overall antenna performance, parasitic patches, slots, and defected ground structures (DGS) have been used. The proposed antenna is found to attain an overall gain and directivity of 4.6 and 6.5 dB after employing all of these modifications, as well as a return loss, S11 of -23.20 dB and VSWR of 1.12. Ansys High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS) software is used for designing and simulation purpose.

articleTitle: Investigating Different Deep learning Models for Classification of Folliculitis
abstract: Folliculitis is a common skin condition that happens when a hair follicle(s) become inflamed. The cause of inflammation can be bacterial or fungal infection, ingrown hair due to hair removal etc. Based on the cause of inflammation in follicle, folliculitis can be categorized into eight different types. If left untreated, it may spread, cause deep infections which can further cause permanent hair loss, scarring, cellulitis and even pass into the bloodstream and become fatal. Dermatologists can usually diagnose folliculitis only by glancing at a patient’s skin. However, in order to find the cause of folliculitis, dermatologists may recommend taking a tissue sample, skin swab and having laboratory tests done. Additionally, a sample of the extracted hair from the troubled areas may be obtained for testing. Using potassium hydroxide, hair samples are microscopically examined to identify a potentially infectious cause. In this paper, we investigate how accurate CNNs are in identifying the type of folliculitis. We will use different Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models like AlexNet, DenseNet201, GoogLeNet, InceptionV3, ResNet50, VGG19 and Xception. The results show that GoogLeNet performs best in identifying the type of folliculitis.

articleTitle: Railroad Track Defect Detection using Convolutional Neural Networks
abstract: Railroad track inspection is crucial to maintain the safety of railway systems and prevent loss of property and lives. Traditional methods of inspection are time-consuming and labour-intensive, and may not always be accurate. To overcome these limitations, machine learning techniques can be used to develop efficient and reliable railroad track inspection systems. In this paper, a machine learning approach for railroad track inspection is proposed, using Python programming language and libraries like TensorFlow and Keras. The model architecture is based on Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), a deep learning algorithm that is well-suited for image analysis. The model is trained on a dataset of images to assess whether the railroad track is defective or not. The proposed algorithm can also be used to monitor the railroad track conditions regularly, reducing the risk of accidents and increasing the safety of the railway system. The use of machine learning in railroad track inspection has numerous benefits, including increased accuracy and speed of inspection, reduced labour costs, and improved safety. The proposed approach can be used as a decision-support tool for railroad inspectors, enabling them to quickly identify potential issues and take appropriate action. Additionally, the algorithm can be easily adapted to different types of railroad tracks and environmental conditions, making it a versatile and flexible solution.

articleTitle: Segmentation in Microscopic Images using Cellular Automata
abstract: This paper investigates cellular automaton (CA)-based segmentation techniques on microscopic images. An image is considered a 2D cellular automaton, and the pixel values are considered the states of the cells. For updating the state of the cell, von Neumann and Moore neighbourhoods have been employed. An existing dataset of microscopic images has been taken, and various segmentation rules have been used for analysis. Additionally, a comparison has been made among the methods, with results demonstrating satisfactory performance. It is also observed that the von Neumann neighbourhood-based approach is producing better results compared to the Moore one.

articleTitle: Controlling Mouse Movement Using Hand Gestures and Voice Commands
abstract: The use of hand gestures and voice commands for controlling computer interfaces has been gaining attention in recent years due to its potential to provide a natural and intuitive input method. This research paper explores the feasibility and usability of using hand gestures and voice commands to control mouse movement, with a particular focus on the technical aspects of implementing such a system and the challenges and limitations associated with this approach. The paper presents a review of the relevant literature, an overview of the existing technologies and applications in this field, and a series of experiments to evaluate the performance and user experience of controlling mouse movement using hand gestures and voice commands. The experimental results demonstrate that the use of hand gestures and voice commands for controlling mouse movement is technically feasible, and has the potential to provide an effective and efficient input method in a variety of contexts, such as gaming, accessibility, virtual and augmented reality, industrial and manufacturing, and healthcare. However, the paper also highlights the need for further research and development to overcome the current limitations and challenges associated with this technology. The paper concludes with recommendations for future research and development in this field, including improvements to the accuracy and reliability of hand gesture and voice recognition systems, as well as the design of intuitive and user-friendly interfaces for controlling mouse movement using these modalities regenerate response .

articleTitle: Design and Development of Time and Memory-Efficient Video Translation Tool
abstract: There are very few open-source tools available for translating videos into different languages. Translating videos into multiple languages is a boon for everyone as it can make communication between people very easy. This paper presents a proposed video translation tool that recognizes the speech and translates the audio into ten new languages. The proposed tool ensures its immense implementation in benign educational platforms and for platforms like YouTube as it eliminates the manual dubbing part. The proposed video translational tool ensures 75% computational time efficiency and 89% CPU memory utilization efficiency.

articleTitle: Implementation of Various Machine Learning Algorithms to Predict Polycystic Ovary Syndrome
abstract: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is a hormonal condition that affects women of reproductive age and can cause acne, facial hair growth, hair loss, infertility, irregular menstrual cycles, and weight gain. Early detection and treatment of PCOS can be challenging. We propose a system that uses machine learning algorithms to predict and diagnose PCOS using minimal parameters. We used a dataset from the open-source database "KAGGLE" and identified the top 10 to 15 features after speaking to gynaecologists. Four machine learning algorithms were used to train, validate and test the model, including the Random Forest classifier, logistic regression, Decision tree classifier and Chi-Square algorithm. Our results show that the Random forest classifier (Chi-Square) has the highest accuracy compared to the other algorithms. Our system can provide early detection, prognosis, and treatment suggestions for PCOS, which can improve the quality of life for women affected by this disorder.

articleTitle: Square Wave Generator with Current Amplifier using DTMOS Technique
abstract: This paper presents a current amplifier (CA)based square wave generator using the DTMOS technique for low power consumption, which are simulated using Cadence in 90nm and 180nm technology. The existing design had a power consumption of 11μW with a supply voltage of +0.75 V and -0.75 V. The proposed square wave generator which is designed using DTMOS had average power consumption around 9μW which gave 18% reduction in power consumption with a supply voltage of +0.75 V and -0.75 V in 90nm technology and about 26% power reduction in 180nm.

articleTitle: Design of Fully Autonomous Vehicles using Deep Learning in an Open World Simulation
abstract: Autonomous vehicles are becoming prevalent in the modern world. Such vehicles either require little or no manual intervention during their operation. However, setting up test scenarios for autonomous vehicles in the real world is a complicated task and has real-world implications in the form of damage to the vehicle itself and damage to public property. Neither industry nor authorities have settled on a standard procedure to carry out tests. Meanwhile, autonomous vehicle tests carried out in a simulation will be much safer. Virtual tests may be re-run countless times, and the data from these tests may be used to create new and unforeseen abstract test scenarios. This research work trains the neural networks AlexNet, AlexNet V2 and InceptionResNet V3 to learn to drive a car in a detailed and diverse simulated world.

articleTitle: Crime Scene Analysis for News Headline Generation
abstract: The news headline generation of crime is a tedious task in journalism reporting that requires analysis and creative skills. Often, human observation and reasoning is subject to error or fallacies, and it is a time-consuming task. Hence an automated headline generation mechanism would greatly benefit media teams. The traditional approach of news headline generation primarily relies on textual data and not on images, which may not always provide a comprehensive understanding of the story. Generating headlines from images requires a deep understanding of the visual content and the ability to extract relevant information. Thus, there is a need for a system that can leverage the power of image detection to automatically generate news headlines that accurately reflect the visual content of an image. This research, which has been proposed by this paper could potentially revolutionize the way news headlines and articles are generated, as it would allow for a more nuanced and accurate representation of the crime scene.

articleTitle: Sentiment Analysis using Multi-objective Optimization-based Feature Selection Approach
abstract: Polarity categorization affects sentiment analysis. Categorization is a fundamental knowledge discovery challenge. Categorization accuracy depends on data quality. Hence, data must be preprocessed to obtain meaningful information. In real-world applications, data is enormous, and many properties are duplicates or useless. The classification depends on feature selection. It finds the best data representation qualities. Feature selection reduces model training time. When unnecessary attributes are eliminated, models learn better. Combinatorial optimization makes feature selection harder. Feature selection balances decreasing features and enhancing classification performance. We propose two multi-objective optimization techniques for the feature selection. The particle swarm optimization (PSO) and Krill Herd Algorithm (KHA) are applied for optimal feature selection. The proposed model consists of key steps such as review pre-processing, multi-objective optimization-based feature selection, and supervised classification. The performance of both PSO-based and KHA-based models is evaluated using the two sentiment analysis datasets. The results show the efficiency of both models in terms of precision, recall, accuracy, and F1-score parameters.

articleTitle: Movie Recommendation System using RNN and Cognitive thinking
abstract: Systems such as Netflix, Amazon, Flipkart, etc. have a huge user base spanning the entire globe. The products and services that these giants provide are also commensurately overwhelming in amount. A particular user can’t be expected to browse through the entire repertoire on his/her own. This is where a recommendation system comes in handy. Such a system can suggest a user similar as well as completely different products and services without any explicit search being carried out by the user. A recommendation system helps increase user engagement and may ensure a loyal consumer base if deployed correctly. Incase of movies, demographic factors such as age and region play an important role in determining user preferences. Age of a person is a latent factor which influences his or her genre preferences. Hence, we have decided to explore the trends that come into play in determining a person’s genre preferences. The main aim is to build a recommendation system for an app in order to increase convenience as well as user interaction using an ensemble Recommendation System model which will utilize 4 different individual learners and combine their results accordingly to provide near perfect recommendations to any user.The movie recommendation system will incorporate cognitive thinking by considering the age of the user and recommending genres based on age group psychology.

articleTitle: Advanced Traffic Sign and Lane Discernment
abstract: Frameworks based on computer vision can be deployed for innumerable tasks assisting the vehicle driver, as such the ADAS has its roots emerging from such deep learning algorithms and CNN architectures. In this paper, a machine learning model has been deployed with the aim of assisting the human driver in analysing the road lanes and the approaching traffic signs in much efficient manner taking into account the adverse weather conditions. The work of analysing the road has been bifurcated into 2 separate tasks which have been carried out in parts. In the first part, the algorithm devised will detect the approaching traffic signs and in the second part, the algorithm would carry out the lane assisting task both of which would be done taking bad weather conditions in consideration. With each iteration of detecting the road signs and classifying the lanes, an additional algorithm would be implemented simultaneously to retrieve clear images removing the fog and other such adverse weather obstructions. Since it is not possible for human drivers to perform the operation required all at once as efficiently as machines, the algorithm devised would ensure the automation of the driving system giving the human driver a sense of relief.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Data Driven Approach on Crop Yield and Fertilizer Efficiency
abstract: India’s economy, which is mostly dependent on agricultural production growth and agroindustry goods, is an agricultural nation. A significant field of research for agricultural production analysis is data mining. Every farmer wants to know how much harvest he may anticipate. Examine a number of relevant factors, such as the location and the pH level used to calculate the soil’s alkalinity. Moreover, the proportion of nutrients such as Nitrogen (N), Phosphorus (P), and Potassium (K). Location is utilized in conjunction with the usage of third-party apps like APIs to identify factors such as weather and temperature, soil type, nutrient value, the quantity of rainfall, and soil composition. All of these parameters will be reviewed, and the data will be trained to develop a model using several efficient machine-learning techniques. The system incorporates a model to give the user precise recommendations regarding the right fertilizer ratio based on field atmospheric and soil data, which improves crop output and increases farmer revenue.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Chaotic Behavior of DC-DC Boost Converter by using Voltage Mode Control
abstract: This paper examines the Boost converter's chaotic behavior. A voltage mode controlled technique is being utilized to analyze the discrete-time mapping to determine the properties of the bifurcation that operate in a closed loop. By varying some parameters while holding others constant, the reference voltage and input voltage are used to examine the bifurcation diagram. It has been noted that the system becomes unstable and splits into two time-periodic systems, four time – periodic systems and then chaos takes over the system. These occurrences have been shown in the bifurcation diagram, therefore the converter's safe operating range can be determined and verified by using the time-domain waveforms and phase plots.

articleTitle: Research on Computer Graphics and Image Design and Visual Communication Design
abstract: The study of computer graphics, image design and visual communication design is the study of the visual appearance of objects, images or scenes. It relates to various techniques for creating these appearances. These technologies include: Computer Aided Design (CAD) system; Computer aided manufacturing; And computer aided visualization (CAV). The goal is to develop new ways to visually create, manipulate, represent, and convey information. Research in this field focuses on creating images for various purposes, such as graphical user interface (GUI), computer games, advertisements, product packaging or posters.

articleTitle: Implementation of PSO based Controllers for Speed Control of BLDC Motor
abstract: BLDC motor is a DC motor with concept of electronic commutation to provide better control over the speed characteristics of the motor compared to a mechanically commutated permanent magnet DC motor. This advantage comes at a cost of pulsating torque output from the motor, which makes the control strategy with speed reference more difficult as power will be pulsating if a constant voltage is set and under load there will be ripples in the actual motor speed. The control mechanism which uses feedback of the controlled parameter to calculate the error to a reference parameter and produces a control signal to minimize this error based on proportional and integral terms of the error signal by using any digital controller. Here we investigate a PID based control strategy v/s a PI control strategy using manual setting, auto-tuned and PSO algorithm. Application point of view we can use it in fully automatic machine, the behaviour of motor in that machines is continuously pulsating so the control factor comes into the role and we need the driver for it, the controlling part study with optimization that how truly we can enhance the result with our motor output. We do the study by simulating the BLDC motor on an industry standard software MATLAB Simulink.

articleTitle: Collision Detection Algorithm Based on Particle System in Virtual Simulation
abstract: In recent years, with the rise of virtual reality, distributed interactive simulation and other technologies, collision detection, especially software collision detection, has become a research hotspot. Accurate collision detection plays an important role in improving the authenticity of the virtual environment and enhancing the immersion of the virtual environment. The complexity and real-time of the virtual environment put forward higher requirements for collision detection. Collision detection algorithm is a method used to determine whether two or more objects collide. Collision detection algorithms are usually used in computer games and simulations, such as the simulation of high-speed vehicles on highways. They can be applied in other fields, including virtual reality (VR) applications. Collision detection algorithm uses various mathematical models to determine when two objects collide with each other. The most common collision detection algorithm is based on detecting the intersection of two parallel lines representing objects at different time positions.

articleTitle: Identification Method of Abnormal Characteristic Data of Power Equipment based on Improved K-Means Algorithm
abstract: Based on the improved k-means algorithm, this paper studies the identification of abnormal feature data of power equipment. Clustering according to the daily load curve can make a fine distinction between users. An accurate load pattern recognition model can also help grid workers to distinguish the load patterns of users, help power companies find their power laws, and provide a theoretical basis for load analysis, forecasting, decision-making and other work of the power system.

articleTitle: Frequency Reconfigurable Microstrip Patch Antenna using Different Reconfiguration Techniques for mm wave Applications
abstract: The presented work is a Y slotted mm –wave reconfigurable micro strip patch antenna. In the proposed antenna frequency reconfigurability is achieved by implementing different electrical reconfiguration techniques PIN Diode, Varactor diodes and RF switches. The frequencies that are produced using our proposed antenna are in a range of 30 - 50 GHz and to find the best PIN diode we worked with a variety of them and compared the outcomes. The proposed antenna is designed using Ansys electromagnetic suite 2019 R1.

articleTitle: Design And Analysis of Artificial Magnetic Conductor (AMC) For 5G Communications
abstract: Artificial Magnetic Conductors (AMC) are analogous magnetic conductors with constrained bandwidth that function optimally only at specified frequencies. The shape of the AMC unit cell is a square patch with four rectangular slots with square rings attached to the centre patch. The AMC is printed on an FR4 substrate that is 3.2 mm thick, has dimensions of 9.6 mm x 9.6 mm x 3.2 mm, and has a relative dielectric constant of 4.4 and a loss tangent/dissipation factor of 0.02. The designed surface is based on the combined unit cells of artificial magnetic conductors (AMCs) forming an array, resonating at a particular band. The bottom of the base is metal ground. To achieve single resonance, the square rings are added and attached to center thus, a band centred at 3.5 GHz. The resonant frequency can be obtained using a single-band AMC in the end. The proposed design is simulated by ANSYS HFSS electronic desktop 2016.1.

articleTitle: New Age Chess Engine
abstract: A chess engine, used in computer chess, is a programme that analyses chess or chess-variant positions and produces a move or series of moves that it deems to be the strongest. The back end of a chess engine often has a command-line interface without any graphics or windowing. Engines are typically used in conjunction with a front end, a windowed Graphical User Interface (GUI) that allows for keyboard, mouse, or touchscreen interaction, such as a chessboard or winboard. It also enables the user to play against various engines without having to become familiar with each one's unique user interface. The availability of numerous chess engines for smartphones and tablets has increased their accessibility. This work aims to develop an artificial intelligence capable of amateur chess play.

articleTitle: Face Mask Detection Using Convolutional Neural Network
abstract: The creation of a real-time face mask detection system based on machine learning is the main goal of this research. With the global COVID-19 pandemic, face mask use has become essential for safety and adherence to regulations. The need to identify individuals not complying with the safety measures in public transit, retail settings, and healthcare facilities inspired this project. The goal is to develop a reliable face mask identification algorithm that performs well regardless of the user's mask type, facial angle, or lighting conditions. This research proposes the use of a Convolutional Neural Network based on deep learning, which is trained on a dataset of images of people wearing/not wearing face masks. The TensorFlow framework and Keras API are used to create the model. Transfer learning is also employed by adapting the MobileNetV2 architecture to improve the model's accuracy with less training data. The effectiveness of the proposed model is assessed on two datasets, one containing real-world photos and the other containing artificially generated images. The model performs well, achieving an accuracy rate of 97.5 per cent and 96.8 per cent, respectively, in identifying face masks in real-time. The proposed system has real-world applicability in settings such as hospitals, airports, and other public spaces, where adherence to safety measures is critical. The model can be further improved to detect other types of Personal Protective Equipment such as gloves and face shields. The project concludes with a CNN-based face mask detection algorithm capable of determining in real-time if a person has a mask on or not. The goal is to develop a reliable face mask identification algorithm that performs well regardless of the user's mask type, facial angle, or lighting conditions.

articleTitle: Open Tool-kit for AI-based Sleep Apnea Scoring
abstract: Sleep is the most essential and fundamental to an individual’s well-being and vitality because it provides for the restoration and re-energizing of both the body and mind. Sleep apnea is a common sleep problem that affects millions of individuals worldwide. It is distinguished by breathing pauses or shallow breathing during sleeping, which can result in a variety of health problems such as heart disease, stroke, and diabetes [1]. Sleep apnea diagnosis and management can be difficult because the cost and time-consuming polysomnography (PSG) testing requires specialized equipment and trained personnel. To address these concerns, we created and validated an artificial intelligence (AI)-based sleep apnea scoring system that analyses electrocardiogram (ECG) signals to predict the severity of sleep apnea. The system analyses ECG signals using 1D-CNN to predict the Apnea-Hypopnea Index (AHI), a measure of the severity of sleep apnea. The tool is organized into three sections: data exploration, data visualization, and prediction, and it is aimed at accurately forecasting patients’ risk of sleep apnea. Our research demonstrates the potential of AI-based approaches for the diagnosis and management of sleep apnea, and we believe that our system can help improve patient outcomes and quality of life.

articleTitle: Automated Library Management System using Face Recognition and OCR
abstract: Traditional methods of managing a library have their disadvantages like long waiting queues and expensive scanner machines. This paper aims to overcome these drawbacks by introducing a new application that makes use of face and text recognition to issue books from the library. The main idea is that a picture of the book with the issuer will be taken from which the required data will be extracted. The account of the user will be created by the library admin by uploading a picture of the face of the user. The application consists of two types of logins - user and admin, where administrators can keep track of user transactions and history. The face recognition algorithm and book recognition algorithm gave an overall accuracy of 99.43% and 82.5% respectively. The user can also see the information related to books and this information is extracted from a third-party API. Further, easy payment and reissue options for the books on the application have also been implemented.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling Optimization of Recognition Algorithm Based on Multi Feature Extraction
abstract: The research on recognition algorithm of multi feature extraction is to find the best method to extract features from images. Researchers used different algorithms and experiments to find the best algorithm. The algorithm adopts the idea of classification and discrimination in the matching and discrimination stage. While inputting the Chinese character image, the input structure characteristics of the Chinese character image are recorded. On this basis, the stroke characteristics of the input unknown Chinese characters are obtained. From the stroke characteristics, the unknown Chinese characters can be roughly classified, which can narrow the range of Chinese characters in the discrimination. Some of these algorithms include: SIFT (scale invariant feature transformation) - this algorithm is used in many applications, such as face detection, image retrieval and target tracking. It can be applied to any type of image, including video sequences. Sift uses a set of parameters based on scale invariance, so it can process any type of image or video sequence without distortion.

articleTitle: Congenital Heart Disease Detection Using Spectral Analysis and CNN
abstract: Congenital Heart Disease (CHD) encompasses a broad range of birth defects that affect the functioning of a normal heart. In this paper, a novel approach has been proposed for the classification of three abnormalities/diseases of CHD, namely Atrial Septal Defect, Ventricular Septal Defect and Atrioventricular Septal Defect when compared to a normal heartbeat. These classes are analyzed by processing an audio file as input into a spectrogram which in turn is an input to the Convolutional Neural Network. Classification accuracy of 97.12% was achieved and can potentially be used in the development of methodology for the diagnosis of CHD.

articleTitle: Improved Design of Computer Network Based on Ant Colony Algorithm
abstract: The improved design of computer network based on ant colony algorithm is a technology that divides tasks into several smaller tasks, and each task is assigned to different staff. The main idea behind the algorithm is that each staff member can assign a task, and then find another solution by searching for other tasks. This process continues until all tasks are completed or no other solution is found. In this way, the team can complete the work faster than before. Facts have proved that this technology is very useful for solving complex problems, such as finding the best path between nodes or calculating the shortest path. Workers not only work alone, but also use pheromone signals to communicate with each other. Ants have amazing ability to find the shortest path between two points without knowing the location of other ants or obstacles in the path in advance. This paper constructs a network simulation system on the OPNET platform, and the improved algorithm shows good performance in the simulation system. At the same time, the performance of the improved algorithm is compared with that of the basic ant colony algorithm in the simulation system. The comparison results show that the improved algorithm can make improvements in the aspects of adaptive, not easy to fall into the local optimal solution and preventing from falling into stagnation.

articleTitle: Strong Correlation Fuzzy Clustering Analysis of Regional Industrial Structure Network Based on Floyd Improved Algorithm
abstract: According to the complex network modeling theory, the input-output direct consumption coefficient is used to construct the industrial structure network model, and the traditional Floyd algorithm is improved to construct a strong correlation matrix, so that the matrix has convergence and uniqueness. The main purpose of this study is to explore the relationship between China's regional industrial structure and economic development. The research question is: is there a strong correlation between the regional industrial structure network and economic development? To answer this question, we use Floyd's improved algorithm (Floyd, 2001) to cluster the data set into groups with different similarities. In addition, we also use fuzzy clustering technology (fuzzy clustering algorithm, FCA) to analyze the factors that affect the similarity of each group. Finally, we compared our results with those obtained by other researchers in similar studies.

articleTitle: High Frequency DC-DC Isolated Converter with Rectification and Synchronous Rectification
abstract: The use of Electric Vehicles (EVs) is increasing day by day and therefore chargers for electric vehicles play a vital role in the evolution of the industry. DC-DC converter is an important part of EV chargers. This paper presents the PSFB (phase-shifted full bridge) dc-dc converter with diode rectification and synchronous rectification. To obtain higher levels of efficiency, PSFB with synchronous rectification is preferred. The converter supports zero voltage switching (ZVS) which aids the converter to work at high frequencies along with advantages like less EMI (Electromagnetic Interference), less stress, lower switching losses, and better efficiency. The PSFB converter with the input DC voltage at 380 V under the zero voltage conditions for both the cases Rectification and Synchronous Rectification at different loads have been studied. A shift in the pulse between Diagonal switches has been maintained which helps in attaining the purpose of the proposed converter. The topology utilizes the resonance between the leakage inductor of high-frequency transformer and parasitic capacitances of full bridge MOSFETS for achieving ZVS. In the case of synchronous rectification, a lesser number of switches has been implemented which helps in having better efficiency than that conventional PSFB. These converters are preferred in medium and high-power applications. The system is designed for 1.1 kW, and the analysis is carried out using MATLAB/Simulink software.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality Snipping Tool
abstract: Augmented Reality is a mixture of the actual and computer-generated worlds. It is accomplished by complementing computer-generated graphics with real-world photographs. AR is frequently characterized as a framework that integrates the physical and virtual worlds, allowing for interaction between virtual and physical items in real-time and precise 3D placement. This is a program that allows you to clip and paste things from your environment into your system. The trim operation removes the specified data from its initial position, the clipboard data is then incorporated whenever a paste command is executed. The information is still available to a program that supports the highlight, allowing for easy information interchange across apps. With recent advances in machine learning, it is now feasible to recognize people and things in our surroundings, Delete the background automatically and deliver the output to the user's workstation. AR has so far been used to bring enhanced images into the real world. The AR Snipping Tool, on the other hand, brings real objects into the digital environment by reversing the process.

articleTitle: Position Sensor Fault Prognostic using Data Driven Approach
abstract: Resolver is a widely used in the feedback loop of the PM traction drive to find exact rotary position of the permanent magnet. In real systems, position error is caused by various factors such as amplitude imbalance, imperfect quadrature, inductive harmonics, reference phase shift, excitation signal distortion or other disturbance signals. This has influence on motor torque production. So, it is crucial to monitor resolver performance so that failed sensor can be easily replaced. This also benefits supply chain to keep the parts ready.This paper demonstrates monitoring the health of the resolver sensor using a data driven approach. The algorithm developed is not only capable of classifying faulty/ healthy resolver, but it can also show the amount of degradation in the resolver sensor. The state-of-the-art developed neural network model is trained on the robust database covering all possible resolver degradations, partial and complete failures. This model is developed on a complete synthetic data tapped from the Simulink model and it is further optimized for the accuracy and size. The algorithm was initially tested on the standalone open-loop resolver model which later extended for the closed-loop version. It also supports commanded mode of prognostics which can detect and classify possible harness faults of the resolver sensor. The proposed algorithm has shown high confidence when it is tested offline on the actual hardware data.

articleTitle: Image Processing Based Pest Detection and Location Sharing to Farmers
abstract: Present days robotic applications along with image processing techniques are extensively used in agriculture sector to determine the fruit ripeness and pest control. The use of Ariel vehicles or waterways for pest control methods frequently results in air and water pollution. This paper discusses reducing the spraying of pesticides to the whole yield by deploying a line follower robot with image processing capability to check the fruit infected by the pest and share the location of the infected plant. Making the yield grow with fewer chemicals there by helping farmers cut the pesticide cost and increasing the fruit cost and stopping agriculture pollution at least to the some extinct.

articleTitle: DRS-UNET: A Deep Learning Approach for Diabetic Retinopathy Detection and Segmentation from Fundus Images
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is the main cause of blindness in working-age adults around the world. Early detection and treatment of DR are critical for preventing vision loss. Image segmentation is a critical step in automated DR detection. UNET is a well-known convolutional neural network design for image segmentation. The typical UNET architecture, on the other hand, may not necessarily be appropriate for DR detection. This study introduces DRS UNET, an unique architecture specifically built for DR detection. DRS UNET incorporates residual blocks and attention mechanisms to improve feature extraction and segmentation performance. The proposed model is trained and tested using publically available datasets, yielding cutting-edge results.

articleTitle: Design of Microstrip Patch Antenna for Bandwidth and Gain Enhancement using Parasitic Patches in Superstrate
abstract: Microstrip patch antennas are utilized in wireless communications, due to their adaptable qualities, including their planar structure, light weight, and ease of production. The patch antenna has a limited bandwidth. This study proposes a patch antenna design that uses parasitic elements to enhance the bandwidth and gain. The proposed antenna uses a FR-4 epoxy substrate with a relative permittivity of 4.4 and is designed for 8.4GHz. Unlike traditional antennas, which deposit parasitic patches on the substrate, this antenna uses parasitic patches in the superstrate. The proposed antenna’s gain is 9.32 dB, and its bandwidth is 2.07 GHz. Applications for the antenna’s operating frequency fall under the S-band and X-band categories. The developed antenna can be applied to mobile and aerospace applications.

articleTitle: Data Detection Poisoning Attack Using Resource Scheme Multilinear Regression
abstract: Machine learning systems have their training to satisfy their data demands in which the industry is pushed to perform increasingly automation and take in more data. The objective of employing these approaches is to become much more popular network security components such as firewalls and anti-virus software such as machine learning methods projected to grow. Data machine learning systems given by well-trained users may be exposed to assaults poisoning data where hostile users insert phony training data and degrade the learning model. Data poisoning attacks may harm the integrity of the machine learning model by adding malicious training models that alter outcomes during testing. Distributed Machine Learning (DML) and Semi-DML are a training that can be realized from a large database when each node can figure out the correct results at an acceptable time. Compared to this diversified environment, the assault will nevertheless disclose possible targets. In this study, suggested approach presented for data detection, poisoning, Data Poison Detection Program based Resource Schemes Multi-Linear Regression (RSMLR) to give superior learning, protection, and support from central sources. Proper distribution of resources in RSMLR helps decrease resource waste. The use of altering data poison detection software may expand the system even more dynamically according to the environment and assault severity. Besides, many of the components would increase the resource usage of the system owing to training.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Dual Band Antenna with Multiple Slots
abstract: Today’s emerging variety of wireless telecommunication services are mainly emphasizing on the design of dual-band antennas. This paper outlines two different antenna designs with dual band microstrip patch antenna for WLAN applications. The two designs resonate at 3.3 GHz & 5.6 GHz and 2.9 & 5.8 GHz respectively. The designs were developed and displayed using CST Microwave studio. The antennas have the same dimensions of 44X41X1.6 mm^3 and differ in number of slots. FR-4 with a dielectric constant of 4.3 was used as the substrate in the designed antennas. The simulation results of the first design have the s-parameter value of -15.1 dB at 3.3 GHz and -22.6 dB at 5.6 GHz. Similarly, the value of s-parameter for the second design are -10.6 dB at 2.9 GHz and -25.3 dB at 5.8 GHz. The VSWR values for the first design are 1.426 at 3.3 GHz and 1.158 at 5.6 GHz, and for the second design, 1.837 at 2.9 GHz and 1.114 at 5.8 GHz.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of High Frequency 16-bit full adder on FPGA Families
abstract: An adder serves as the main structural component of any contemporary ALU-based processor. It is known that addition is a very fundamental operation that is utilized in almost every computational operation. As the result, the adder circuit's performance will have a significant impact on the processor's performance. The general adders such as half adder, full adder, ripple carry adder, carry skip adder and carry look-ahead adder, fall short of the high- performance processor's expectations in terms of frequency. In this paper, to meet with the desired requirement we proposed a high-frequency 16-bit full adder architecture which has been simulated using Verilog on Xilinx ISE 14.7 tool and implemented on Virtex-5, Virtex-7, Spartan-6 FPGA families and we compared it with the typical 16-bit adder. We have observed that the proposed architecture has frequency enhancement of 468%, 447% & 325% in Spartan-6, Virtex-5 & Virtex-7 respectively than conventional 16-bit adders. Verification is done using QuestaSim 10.4e we achieved 100% coverage.

articleTitle: Exploring the Capability of NASNet Model for Plant Classification on GRASP-125 Dataset
abstract: Plant classification and identification, which has strong ties to both computer science and taxonomy, is becoming an increasingly dynamic area of research within the field of computer recognition. Researchers have utilized different techniques including image processing, pattern recognition, and machine learning to develop systems capable of accurately identifying and classifying plants. Access to large image databases and advances in image processing and artificial intelligence have led to the development of highly accurate plant identification systems. These systems have the potential to greatly reduce the amount of time and proficiency required for plant identification, which are only achievable by skilled taxonomists. In this study, we experimented with the Greek vAScular Plants (GRASP) dataset, consisting of images across 125 different plant species native to the mountains belonging Oiti and Parnassus in central Greece, to perform automatic plant identification using a deep learning approach namely NASNet. These plant species, which include both rare and aesthetically pleasing varieties, are often found along popular hiking routes in the region. Our method for plant classification utilizes deep learning techniques on the GRASP-125 dataset, with the goal of improving the accuracy and efficiency of plant identification.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Based PV-Battery system for a Standalone Microgrid
abstract: This paper proposes a standalone microgrid in integration with photovoltaic array and battery storage system based on fuzzy logic MPPT technique. Solar PV systems are affected by variables like temperature and irradiance and have nonlinear I-V characteristics. Fuzzy logiv MPPT can handle nonlinearities better than any other conventional MPPT technique. in addition with the battery storage system the microgrid can be operate in both islanded mode and grid connected mode. To simulate this system with Solar PV and battery storage system MATLAB Simulink is used. This model can be used more efficiently for remote locations or villages where electricity supplies are not present or it gets affected by too much load shedding. Microgrids in integration with the renewable sources is the future for electrical power generation.

articleTitle: E-mail Spam Detection Using Machine Learning
abstract: Spam e-mail detection involves applying algorithms and rules to locate and delete unwanted or unwelcome e-mails. These algorithms and guidelines frequently look at an e-mail's content, the sender's reputation, and other factors to determine if it is likely to be spam. For users' inboxes to be free of unwanted or potentially hazardous information, the ability to recognize spam e-mails is essential. Spam e-mail detection is critical for protecting customers from unsolicited and potentially harmful information that can clog their inboxes and compromise their security. Mails are Categorized as 'Spam' or 'Ham' in the dataset. By performing analysis and applying machine learning algorithms for building the predictive system, the model will predict the upcoming mail as spam or ham according to the research on the data. Various machine learning classification algorithms are used, out of which the Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) gives the most accurate results and prediction over the data with about 98% accuracy.

articleTitle: Commutator Surface Defect Detection Algorithm based on Genetic Algorithm
abstract: The research of commutator surface defect detection algorithm based on genetic algorithm is to use genetic algorithm to detect commutator surface defects. The main purpose of this study is to find a method to detect commutator defects. GA will be used to detect defects on the commutator surface by using data obtained from scanning electron microscopy (SEM). Based on this, we can easily detect and measure the defects on the surface of the commutator. This research works with genetic algorithms, which are developed to solve problems related to computer vision and image processing. To solve these problems, we use three basic rules: mutation, crossover and selection. This study can be used as an effective tool to analyze and repair the defective parts of motors, generators, transformers and so on.

articleTitle: Even-Odd Sorting Network for Fast Binary Counters
abstract: In various digital signal processing devices, the efficiency of data multiplication is a common performance limiter and the critical route includes the parallel summing of multiple operands. Therefore, high compression is used to speed up the summation process. Binary counters with specific design are required to reduce some efficiency parameters in the partial products compared to traditional one’s counters. In this project, we introduce a technique for quickly saturated binary counters used to design multipliers. This method involves a design of a sorter network using different sorting algorithm that is "Even-Odd" sorting. By using this technique, (15,4) and (31,5) binary counters are designed and further optimization of the parameters are compared in terms of latency and area. These counters can be further implemented in8 × 8, 16 × 16 bit multipliers and area-delay product, powerdelay product values can be obtained. These sorter networks and design of binary counters are programmed and synthesized in Xilinx Vivado tool.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence (AI) Enabled Music Player System for User Facial Recognition
abstract: Artificial Intelligence (AI) refers to the use of advanced computational algorithms and technologies to replicate or simulate human intelligence in machines or computer systems. Human expression is incredibly important in determining a person’s current condition and mood. AI is utilized to analyze human facial expressions and extract emotions based on features such as cheeks, forehead, eyes, and smiles. In addition, “songs” refers to an expressive medium that has always been the best option for analyzing and comprehending human emotions. The proposed ’smart music player' is a programmed system that functions under the assumption that we can tell someone’s mood by the expression on his/her face. This model that recognizes facial micro-expressions with multicultural facial expression details, recommends music in accordance with corresponding mood. It is developed using a combination of song’s features and micro-expression recognition technology of convolutional neural network. To do this, group facial expressions into seven distinct emotional groups, including happy, sad, angry, neutral, surprise and disgust. The primary objective of this study paper is to present an overview of a useful music player and social companion that automatically creates a playlist that will brighten your day based on your emotional condition, along with recommendations for future studies in the field of recommendation systems.

articleTitle: An Assistance System for Driver’s Safety based on YOLO Algorithm
abstract: The improvement of driving machine safety and accident prevention is one of the industry's top priorities. Many folks don't adhere to the legal traffic norms and regulations. This may also contribute to traffic collisions. Most traffic collisions are not done on purpose. Serious mistakes like being drowsy or exhausted might have a negative impact. An Aid System for Driver Safety has been put in place to prevent similar scenarios. This device has the capacity to get better driving comfort and security for drivers. This technique may be quite beneficial to elderly people as well. A human-machine interface was used in the construction of an assistance system for drivers' safety, which helps to increase traffic safety. Accidents which are caused by human errors can also be reduced. Some common safety technologies like wearing seatbelts and airbags are not able to prevent road destructions. An Assistance System for Driver’s Safety also alerts the driver during problems such as drowsiness, colliding objects, etc. This system helps in maintaining the stability of the vehicle under critical situations.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of DC Motor using GWO and FPA
abstract: This paper aims at comparing various PID tuning methodologies. An armature-controlled DC motor has been modeled in Simulink using its actual parameters for the study. The metaheuristic approaches i.e., Flower Pollination Algorithm and Grey Wolf Optimization have been coded on MATLAB and the tuned parameters have been imported on Simulink to check their response. These algorithms work on ITAE as their objective function. Finally, the results of the controllers are analyzed and distinguished by values of Rise Time (Tr), Peak Overshoot (Mp), and Peak Time (Tp).

articleTitle: Smart Waste Segregation Using IoT
abstract: Rapid expansion in the quantity and variety of solid and hazardous waste as a consequence of continued economic development, urbanization, and industrialization poses a growing challenge for national and municipal governments to ensure efficient and long-term waste management. According to estimates, the total amount of municipal solid trash produced worldwide in 2006 was 2.02 billion tonnes, a rise of 7% annually since 2003. (Global Waste Management Market Report 2007). To reduce the risk to the patient and public health and safety, as well as an environmental hazard, waste management, transportation, and disposal must be carefully handled. There is currently no system in place for households to separate dry, moist, and metallic garbage. In order to send household waste directly for processing, an automated waste segregator is suggested in this study, which is an affordable, simple-to-use alternative. It is intended to separate the garbage into metallic, wet, and dry waste. The automated waste segregator uses a moisture sensor to discriminate between wet and dry trash and an inductive proximity sensor to detect metallic objects. According to experimental findings, the automated waste segregator has been effectively used to accomplish the classification of waste into dry, wet, and metallic waste.

articleTitle: Divya Wear- Haptic Vest Pattern Design and Analysis
abstract: This work evaluated a haptic vest prototype designed to assist visually impaired individuals with navigation. Testing and feedback from 12 individuals with normal vision indicated that the sensing of vibrations provided by the prototype was adequate, but the comfort level was not satisfactory. Recommendations were made to improve the tightness of the vest by replacing the threads with a zipper or Velcro. Feedback on vibration pattern recognition suggested that two patterns out of seven considered were highly effective compared to other patterns. The patterns play a vital role in providing a cue to its wearers by providing timely essential information. Highly comfortable and distinguished patterns are key in developing cueing patterns for haptic wearable such as vest or DivyaWear in this case. Future developments could involve identifying new vibration patterns, repositioning motors, and integrating a camera for obstacle detection and visual feedback.

articleTitle: A Conditional Feedthrough Pulsed Flip-Flop using MTCMOS Technique
abstract: A Conditional Feedthrough Pulsed Flip-Flop Using MTCMOS technique is proposed in this paper. Power and delay are optimized in this paper compared to the existing model with the help of MTCMOS technique and the proposed model has achieved less power by 35% and delay by 21%. The proposed results were achieved using FinFET 22-nm technology where multiple simulations of the circuit have been performed to achieve the proposed results.

articleTitle: PSO-Super Twisting SMC for Balancing the TWIP using LEGO EV3 Model
abstract: This paper presents a PSO-based tanh super twisting sliding mode controller (PSO-STSMC) for the balancing of two-wheeled inverted pendulum (TWIP). Here, a mathematical model that incorporates the dynamics of the LEGO EV3 TWIP is taken into consideration. A Sliding Mode Control (SMC) is designed initially, and then the switching surface is synthesized by converting the state space model into standard form. Then the pole placement technique is used to determine the sliding surface constants. Then the corresponding system response is plotted.
