To apply the Robust web service recommendation strategy to the textual data of microblogs, the framework for the Recommendation system based on deep learning models on Robust web service recommendation makes use of a dummy variable approach for categorization. Within this study, we provide the planning and analysis of experiments for such a system.

articleTitle: Depression Analysis Based on EEG and ECG Signals
abstract: In covid -19 situation, most people suffered from stress. Continuous stress can lead to severe psychological and even physical disorders. To detect the depression manually is time-consuming, tedious, and requires expertise. The present system is used for detecting and analyzing depression based on EEG and ECG signals. The system layout strategies and calculations include extraction and choice strategies for classification and for deteriorating techniques, as well as combination methodologies. The EEG and ECG feature are extracted and sent for the classification. From ECG signals the ST segment, P wave and QRS wave as features extracted. The most prominent features are analyzed from EEG signals are Hjorth activity (HA), standard deviation, entropy and band power alpha. The Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) autoencoder and RNN deep learning model approach were used for depression analysis.

articleTitle: Statistics and Research on Producer Services and Industrial Manufacturing based on Data Analysis Technology
abstract: Since the middle of the last century, producer services have played an increasingly prominent role in economic development. The budding of a new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation has pushed the development of productive services into a new stage. Productive services have become an important direction of industrial technology and economic development. In contrast, although Chinese manufacturing has a place in the world, its development is facing a big but not strong dilemma due to its weak manufacturing technology. How to get out of the dilemma of "Made in China" and how to support industries have become a difficult problem for China's economic development. The statistics and research of producer services and industrial manufacturing based on data analysis technology in this paper is an application program that helps analyze real-time statistical data of different industries. The software can be used for various purposes, such as market research, product development, sales forecasting, customer relationship management (CRM), etc. It provides users with information about the production time and cost of each product produced by the company or organization. The software also allows you to clearly understand the monthly profit and loss of the enterprise. At this stage, China's industrial manufacturing industry has not emerged from the end of the global industrial chain. The main reason is the lack of technological innovation activities and the low level of technological innovation. The improvement of innovation efficiency in industrial manufacturing depends largely on R&D technology investment and R&D human resources investment. On the other hand, China's regional economic development is not balanced, and there are large differences between the east and the west. There are differences in the mechanism and degree of the impact of technological innovation input on innovation efficiency in industrial manufacturing in different regions.

articleTitle: WONGA: The Future of Personal Finance Management – A Machine Learning-Driven Approach for Predictive Analysis and Efficient Expense Tracking
abstract: The financial literacy of Sri Lankans is relatively low, leading to difficulties in managing personal finances. This research presents a smart solution to simplify the complexities associated with money management and assist individuals in managing their finances more efficiently to achieve better financial health without requiring a comprehensive knowledge of money management from the user. The proposed system automates personal finance management with minimal user effort, reducing manual data entry by tracking cash flow by utilizing SMS messages and expense bills to extract bank transaction data and cash expenditures. Each extracted expense will automatically be categorized into the correct expense category. The system also generates a custom budget plan for each user based on spending patterns to help them stay on the budget throughout the month and avoid irrational overspending. Furthermore, the system provides a mechanism to predict future expenses associated with upcoming events based on calendar events, allowing users to devise the most efficient budget plan and avoid facing financially unprepared events in the upcoming month. All these smart solutions are bundled up in the "Wonga" mobile application to help users make better financial decisions to achieve personal financial success.

articleTitle: Origami Based Reconfigurable Square Flasher Antenna
abstract: In this paper, we develop a reconfigurable Square Flasher antenna via Origami. The developed antenna follows the Origami flasher model, and comprises of two different radiation patterns in state of folding (SoF) and state of unfolding (SoUF) which enables reconfigurability within the antenna. Further, using aluminium as antenna material we conduct experiments for validating antenna. The results show that antenna functions within frequency range of 850-1300 MHz in SoF and SoUF thereby combining features of a directional and omni-directional antenna.

articleTitle: Application of Multi Level Inverter Using MMC and FACTS in Distributed Energy Systems
abstract: The paper proposes a new 1-ϕ Wind Energy Inverter which can be used for Wind Applications. The Proposed Inverter uses MMC topology so as to provide high efficiency, high power quality, and increased reliability. MMC topology has also other advantages such as low harmonic distortion, improved voltage balancing, and high voltage levels. The Wind Energy Inverter also has FACTS properties which regulates reactive and active power. The Inverter is installed in between wind turbines and the Power Grid. It converts incoming Direct Current from wind turbines to Alternating Current and maintains a target power factor, by regulating reactive power. Capacitor banks and external STATCOMS are no longer used, lowering the system’s total cost. The suggested inverter’s overall harmonic distortion is less than 5 percentage, which meets with IEEE specifications.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Hybrid Microgrid System for Vehicle Electrical Charging Stations
abstract: DC and AC electricity charge EVs at the charging station. DC charges quickly, but AC charges slowly. The microgrid has few AC loads but lots of DC quick charging. High harmonic current from several AC and DC conversions will increase power usage and decrease microgrid solidity and richness. Hence, the traditional hybrid AC/DC microgrid that mainly relies on an AC microgrid fails in such conditions. Charging stations powered by a hybrid microgrid may help regulate power flow and reduce transmission losses in today's power grid. Nevertheless, when battery electric vehicles (BEVs) are charged without coordination with the hybrid microgrid, the associated renewable energy sources are not used to their full potential. In addition, a multiport charging facility is part of the growth of new charging stations that is expected to strain the power grid. Our unique hybrid microgrid system for electric car charging stations is proposed as a solution to these problems. To better accommodate electric vehicles (EVs) on the grid, this research proposes and evaluates a novel form of photovoltaics (PV) hybrid DC/AC microgrid for EV charging stations. Components of the proposed model include renewable energy sources, a diesel generator, a PV model, storage devices, linear loads, and non-linear loads (RESs). The effectiveness of the suggested model for electrical car charging stations is shown by the simulation results.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review on Deep learning Techniques for Crop Yield Prediction
abstract: deep learning is a contrivance for yield prediction in agriculture domain. Various deep learning techniques have been used on crop yield prediction system research. In this paper, we perform comprehensive review to extract the most widely used algorithms, most relevant features, evaluation matrices used for result validation, challenges , limitation and future research scope of the crop yield prediction system. We investigated 25 papers of yield prediction using deep learning and according to our analysis Crop yield prediction involves massive dataset consisting of Metrological parameters data, Satellite image data, Soil parameters data, other observational parameters so for that more rapidly and precise predictions can be made by using the deep learning algorithm such as Deep Neural Networks, Long-Short Term Memory, Convolution Neural Networks, which can be evaluated using Root mean square error (RMSE). Also, given research scope, future development, challenges in crop yield predictions system using deep learning.

articleTitle: Electrical and Electronic Architecture of an ROV
abstract: A remotely operated underwater vehicle (ROV) is an unmanned vehicle which is controlled from an onshore operator for offshore tasks. ROV finds its use in many underwater applications where direct human interference is not possible. The remote control of an ROV is achieved using a tethered cable for power transmission and communication. In this research work focus has mainly been laid on the vehicle’s embedded and electronic composition. The vehicle operates on a 48V power supply and communicates with the onshore system using the RS485 communication protocol.

articleTitle: Hydro Power Plant Performance Optimization Using Metaheuristics
abstract: In this paper, using MATLAB/Simulink software environment, connectivity of multiple power plant component models is established for simulating the operation of a typical small hydropower plant with open channels, regulators, Semi Kaplan turbines, synchronous generators, and exciters. To reduce the errors of various types during the transient phase, the simulated model is augmented with a PI controller. Firefly and cuckoo Search optimization are used for tuning the PI controller parameters. It is observed that Firefly optimization provides the best tuning of PI controller parameters for this problem resulting in better error reduction as compared to Cuckoo search optimization.

articleTitle: CNN and Arduino based Stress Level Detection System
abstract: A stress detector is a gadget that keeps track of physiological stress markers. Most of these tools concentrate on your heart. Your heart rate is monitored with heart rate monitors and they provide feedback. Other methods to track heart rate activities have recently been developed by wearables designers.For people, the COVID-19 outbreak is quite stressful. A sickness can create excessive fear and anxiety, which can lead to powerful emotions. In reality, a situation that makes someone feel anxious or upset can frequently set off the sense of stress. A sensation of fear, worry or unease is known as anxiety. The ratio of health care is progressively declining as the world’s population continues to increase. New technology must be developed as quickly as feasible to track people’s physical and mental health throughout their daily lives. A device that gathers the necessary data is needed, as well as an algorithm that can recognise a person’s behaviour from photographs taken using a standard camera, when stress is detected using a thermal image and biological signal. The deep neural network that uses facial landmarks as input can benefit from this fact because a person’s eye, mouth and head motions vary while they are under stress.

Author Keywords: facial landmark and convolutional neural network

articleTitle: Implementation of PMOS Biased Sense Amplifier Using Tanner EDA tool
abstract: Sense amplifiers contribute to the effectiveness, practicality, and durability of memory devices. In the following paper, two new sense amplifier schematics seemed to enhance the performance of memory circuits. The suggested circuits, as opposed to traditional circuits, utilize a PMOS biasing strategy that allows for high output impedance while minimizing sensing delay and power consumption. The circuits function similarly to conventional sense amplifiers, however these circuits have been found to exhibit higher efficiency of their absorbed power and sensing delay. Presented sense amplifiers’ performance was evaluated through simulations leveraging Tanner EDA software and a 180nm technology. In accordance with simulations, the presented circuits functioned consistently with the theoretical analysis, demonstrating their sound design. The results of this study suggest that the sense amplifiers that have been suggested might improve the performance and usefulness of memory circuits found in a number of electronic devices. The reduced power consumption and sensor latency may lead to longer battery life and faster processing times, which may enhance user experience.

articleTitle: Complex Scene Loading Optimization Based On Virtual Reality Algorithm
abstract: In recent years, virtual reality has gradually become a hot topic, which involves many model scenes. However, large-scale scenes cannot be directly imported into the game engine due to their large size, and complex scene models need to be optimized for rendering before they can be used. This paper focuses on the optimization of complex scene loading based on virtual reality algorithm. Virtual reality algorithm is a method to optimize the loading of complex scenes. It can be used to optimize the loading of scenes containing many objects, such as large cities or battlefields. The algorithm works by dividing the whole scene into several sub scenes and calculating the number of objects in each sub scene. In this way, it can find out which sub scenes have not been loaded and should be loaded first, so that after all other parts are loaded, they will be displayed on the screen. In this case, the user will see a smooth transition between different parts of the scene, instead of seeing a sudden change in his /her viewpoint when one part is loaded.

articleTitle: Contactless Palm Recognition System
abstract: The objective of this paper is to analyze the design and development of a contactless attendance system which verifies the identity of different users through their palm print. 21 distinct points in each users’ palm are analyzed using Google’s MediaPipe module. Further, a backend database and corresponding user interface with authentication is developed for the purpose of storing user’s details and palm prints.

articleTitle: Migration of Knowledge Base Articles between Salesforce Cloud Instances
abstract: The data migration across platforms has tremendously increased from past decades due to the business acquisitions and emerging start-ups. During these acquisitions all the assets, clients, customers, policies have to be migrated or transferred to the acquired company. One of such challenging migration is data migration from one cloud to cloud. There exist millions of records hosted in the servers, clouds' that have to be migrated without any data loss, data breaches in a valid notation and format. All the business these days are relying on the Customer Relationship Management (CRM) tools in improving the customer services and building stronger customer interactions. One of such CRM is Salesforce. The information present in the source salesforce org which includes metadata, flows, validations, workflows, triggers will have to be migrated to the destination salesforce org. Unlike other objects, the knowledge base articles can’t be migrated using the common migration process. Knowledge articles needs a unique way of exporting, formulating the data, importing the data of same or cross knowledge experience between salesforce instances. The study, analysis and migration of salesforce knowledge base is interpreted in this paper.

articleTitle: Portable Frmaework For Real time Water Quality Assessment and Analytics
abstract: Water quality assessment has become a matter of urgency in today’s world due to water pollution and other factors. Conventional laboratory methods are time consuming and laborious. The paper aims at providing this service to stakeholders from industries including agricultural and pisciculture, as well as members of the general public in an efficient manner using IoT. Hardware is implemented in the form of a device that maps the water body by collecting its coordinates via GPS. The data collected from pH, salinity/conductivity, TDS, temperature, turbidity sensors is used to calculate the water quality index (WQI) through Horton’s method and are continuously assessed in real time after GSM transmission to cloud. Analytical patterns and trends are identified and visualized using BigQuery and customized dashboards are presented to the stakeholders via website using tools like Looker Studio and Google Sites. Further queries from stakeholders in regards to the dashboards can be asked and clarified through the site. Each stakeholder can only view the dashboards and viewpoints that are relevant to his/ her interest and concern. Sudden variations and deterioration in water quality can be notified to the stakeholders via SMS. Historical data being stored to the Cloud, can later be retrieved to identify long term trends and outliers.

articleTitle: Quality Evaluation Model of Automatic Machine Translation based on Deep Learning Algorithm
abstract: With the continuous development of computer technology, machine translation methods have also experienced a long research process. In recent years, the research of artificial neural network has brought new solutions to machine translation. The application of sequence sequence model has made a qualitative leap in the performance of machine translation. The training of neural machine translation model depends on large-scale bilingual parallel data, which contains sufficient knowledge for machine learning. The training process is the process of data representation and knowledge extraction. How to use data enhancement methods to make model learning easier and knowledge extraction more sufficient is an important research topic. Automatic machine translation quality evaluation model based on deep learning algorithm is a method to evaluate the quality of automatic machine translation. This paper introduces the basic idea of qemt and some examples. We also give an example to illustrate how to use it to evaluate the quality of automatic machine translation. Qemt (quality evaluation model) is a method to evaluate the quality of automatic machine translation by comparing human translations generated by different natural language processing models such as part of speech markers or semantic similarity measures.

articleTitle: Research on Visual Communication Optimization Method based on Simulation Technology
abstract: The research on visual communication optimization methods based on simulation technology is to simulate various factors in image processing to optimize the quality and quantity of images. This study aims to improve the quality and efficiency of image processing. In addition, it aims to reduce costs related to image processing. Many companies around the world, including Japan and South Korea, have conducted such research. As a simulation technology, simulation optimization is used to study and analyze various phenomena of human vision, such as color vision and vision. Simulation technology is applied in fields such as engineering design, advertising design, and industrial planning. It can be said that this method provides people with more realistic images than traditional methods. By visualizing the simulation results through the interface, users can intuitively understand the working status and performance bottlenecks of the communication network. Finally, targeted communication optimization is carried out to improve the performance and stability of the communication network by gradually adjusting parameters and other methods. The experimental results show that this method can effectively improve the performance of communication networks and has high practical value.

articleTitle: Trademark Detection Algorithm Based on Artificial Intelligence
abstract: In the field of computer vision, the performance of deep learning in target detection task has exceeded the past and reached the highest level in history. The trademark detection algorithm is based on artificial intelligence. Artificial intelligence based algorithms are used to detect trademarks of specific products. Its working principle is to compare the images of products with those of other products with similar images in the database. Different from the target detection task in the open field, the trademark detection task has the characteristics of large target scale span, complex scene change, serious target rotation deformation and a large number of small targets. At present, the mainstream target recognition algorithm has low accuracy in the recognition task in the trademark field. The trademark detection algorithm compares the images and finds the similarity between them. If there is any similarity, it will be marked as a trademark item. The algorithm is developed using artificial intelligence and machine learning technology to detect trademarks in images or video frames captured from different angles.

articleTitle: An FSS Based Dual-band Bandstop Filter for Minimizing Interference in C Band Satellite Downlink Communication
abstract: Over the decades, C-band frequencies have gained popularity in various wireless systems including mobile, radar, and satellite communications. However, this frequency band suffers from substantial interference due to sharing of its spectrum with Broadband Wireless Access networks and several operational VSATs. This paper presents a dual-band bandstop filter implemented using frequency selective surface (FSS) for minimizing interference in the C band downlink satellite system. The dual-band FSS unit cell is designed using a circular ring with rectangular slots on the top layer and a Swastika symbol at the bottom, which has a dimension of 0.32λ<inf>0</inf>×0.32λ<inf>0</inf> (free space wavelength at 6 GHz). The performances of the proposed filter in terms of transmission coefficients, reflection coefficients, surface current distribution, and angular stability are analyzed. The results demonstrate that the filter resonates at two distinct frequencies of 5 GHz and 7.2 GHz within the C band. It is revealed that the dual-band filter exhibits angular stability up to 30° in both TE and TM mode polarizations.

articleTitle: Data Steganography Using LSB, X-OR & AES Algorithm
abstract: The way of hiding or storing your data to make it masked for private information without getting it stolen from outsiders. It is an effective way of hiding important information for various uses and is termed steganography. It is generally a technique that is used for masking or hiding your required data inside any of the ordinary, non-secret, data without getting it detected by threats. The binding of data with secret keys helps the information getting it tough to be in contact with unknown entities. To make it gettable to a known entity the masked information including files, data, images, audio, video, etc the data must be stored with some keys. To make the data unnoticeable the secret message must be stored in something that is not been imaginable or which is not secret. Hence the data getting hacked is at least risk. This is a technique which is been used for thousands of years. The secret force uses the steganography technique ages for keeping important data safe and secured from getting used by enemies. For example, in the Ancient Greek system, the method of hiding the message used by the Greek people was just like writing the message on wood and after that, the message on the written wood would be waxed to obscure it. In the same way in today’s world, there are various algorithms and techniques to hide secret information for various uses along with proper ways to manage to encrypt and decrypt the data. But on the other hand, various intruders kept on attacking the steganographic data for their benefit whether it can be for educational purposes or blackmailing purposes. Therefore, we have created a module that is made for handling the secret message encryption and decryption of message from various modes that usually seems to be unnoticeable, which is simply the day-to-day media use as the general purpose of uses by users. In this model, simple masking of data is been managed to hide the data. The model uses the AES algorithm to make it more secure along with the LSB technique. It can also be using RSA or other cryptographic algorithms but we are more concerned with the basics of the model hence we are using the simple algorithm for basic educational purposes.

articleTitle: Comparative Study of PI and Fuzzy Logic Controlled D-STATCOM For Improving Power Quality
abstract: Power quality (PQ) improvement is a key area of research where all the stake holders such as residential and industrial sectors are accountable to administer the power effectively and efficiently. Distribution power systems usually suffer from degraded power quality issues caused by lack of sufficient reactive power support at the time of disturbances. This research work is based on distribution static compensator (D-STATCOM) for load balancing, harmonic distortion reduction, and reactive power compensation in a three phase, three wire distribution system feeding non-linear load. The proposed control method is designed utilizing a FUZZY logic controller and is based on the synchronous reference frame theory. For improved switching of D-STATCOM, the derived reference current signal from the control algorithm is compared in the hysteresis band current controller. The effectiveness of D-STATCOM with a fuzzy logic controller is evaluated and contrasted for regulating DC voltage and reducing harmonic distortion. The suggested approach offers efficient reactive power compensation and harmonic distortion reduction. MATLAB/SIMULINK is used to simulation and analysis of the results.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Hyperspectral Image Classification Methods
abstract: Hyperspectral imaging is an effective tool in various areas of application such as medical, agricultural, Satellite imagery, defense and weather forecasting. The latest hyperspectral image (HSI) sensor technology is able to cover large areas with spatial, visual and temporal adjustment. In order to extract important spectral-spatial information from such HSI data, there is a need of space and time complexity algorithms. In the last few decade different development has been made in this hyperspectral imaging. In this field, HSI classification has key challenges such as size of data, insufficient samples in training and spectral variability. While extracting important information from HSI data, there is a need of efficient methods to extract significant features and the appropriate selection of filters to achieve reliable result. In this paper experimental work done on standard publically available databases Indian Pines for HSI classification using SVM, KNN and CNN. We have proposed wavelet-CNN method where factor analysis is used for reduction of extracted transform domain features. The proposed methodology reduces the space and time complexity of the HSI classification model. The proposed algorithm improves overall accuracy of classification of HSI data up to 99.86% and it also reduces the time complexity to 3.56 seconds.

articleTitle: Arrhythmias Classification by using STFT-based Spectrograms, Transfer Learning and Concatenation of features
abstract: Cardiology diagnosis relies heavily on analyzing electrocardiograms (ECGs). It is divided into extraction of features and classifying patterns of ECGs. New developments in artificial intelligence show that a deep neural network trained on a large quantity of data could do feature extraction directly from the information and classify different kinds of heart arrhythmias. The purpose of this study is to extract features using transfer learning models from data. The process of transfer learning is using a model which is been trained on a dataset to predict data from a new dataset. Using two pre-trained models, Visual Geometry Group (VGG-16) with a 16-layer deep model architecture and MobileNet with a different kind of convolutional layer architecture known as Depth-wise Separable Convolution, which is much less complex and faster. In this proposed methodology, the ECG signal in time domain is converted into spectrograms signals, using the Short Time Fourier Transform (STFT). The signals belonging to different kinds of heat beats were given as input to two pre-trained deep CNNs- (MobileNet, VGG16) models. The features were extracted and concatenated from both models to create a combined new model, resulting in an accuracy of 92 percent.

articleTitle: High Conversion Ratio Sepic Converter With Reduced Switch Stress
abstract: This investigation used a four terminal PWM hefty step-up switch cell is added to an existing single ended principal inductor (sepic) circuit. Step-up and step-down outputs are provided by the sepic converter. By adding the proposed four terminal switch to the sepic converter circuit, the circuit's conversion output increases when compared to the existing one. These days, converters are fairly common. Each converter has unique advantages, disadvantages, and operating principles. The voltage (potential) at the output of a particular kind of DC/DC regulator is the single-ended primary-inductor converter (sepic)., may be larger, lower, or equivalent to the input. The amount of time that the control switch controls the SEPIC’s output. Typically, a single switch in a sepic converter circuit is under stress while being turned on and off. A new circuit is added to the sepic converter’s existing circuit in order to alleviate stress.

articleTitle: Intelligent Vehicle Road Detection and Early Warning Algorithm Based on Vision
abstract: The research of vision based intelligent vehicle road detection and early warning algorithm is a very important research field in the field of computer science. It is carried out by different researchers from different countries, who have contributed to this field with their valuable research. The main purpose of this study is to develop an intelligent system that can use cameras installed at different locations along the road to detect the presence of other vehicles, pedestrians and cyclists. These cameras are used to detect these objects to avoid accidents or other events that may lead to death or injury. This research includes the development of algorithms for target detection, tracking and recognition, which will help to identify targets.

articleTitle: Network Intrusion Detection System using Reinforcement learning
abstract: Our research on the efficacy of deep reinforcement learning helps us comprehend the challenges encountered by NIDS (DRL). To find network anomalies, we suggest integrating Adversarial/Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning with Deep QLearning (AE-DQN). We compare our suggestions on the NSL-KDD dataset with the KDDTest+ dataset. In this article, we take a look at the difficulty of reducing an infinite number of possible categories down to only five. Our strategy yielded an overall F1 score of 79% and an accuracy of 80% across the board. Furthermore, our proposed method outperforms the Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) IDS (2) and the Adversarial Reinforcement Learning with SMOTE (AESMOTE) IDS in terms of the variety of assaults it can identify, as shown by its performance on the NSL-KDD dataset (3). Our major aim going forward is to enhance detection efficiency against different kinds of threats.

articleTitle: Analysis and Evaluation of Characteristics of Li-ion Battery using Simulink and Impacts of Ambient Temperature on Pure Electric Vehicle
abstract: The automotive sector has shifted towards Electrically Powered Vehicles due to the increase in energy demand, the gradual limiting of fossil fuels, and environmental issues. The Efficiency of traction of battery packs affects the performance and range of EVs. Temperature significantly affects the rate of Lithium-ion battery deterioration as well as the performance of the chemical reaction that takes place inside the battery which impacts the overall performance of the vehicle. The internal temperature of the battery leads to the dropdown of resistance which cause lots of heat generation. In the same way, external temperature i.e., ambient temperature also impacts the performance of the battery. An optimal temperature range is required for the better performance of the vehicles. In battery electric vehicles, there is a sharp decrease in driving range in cold conditions as compared to combustion engines, which is the drawback of battery electric vehicles. This paper includes the analysis of Li-ion battery characteristics under different conditions by using the UDDS drive cycle and an analysis of ambient temperature impacts on EV’s range in automotive vehicle operation.

articleTitle: Voice Interactive Door and Window Control System
abstract: This paper presents a Voice Interactive Door and Window Control System that is one of many options that can improve the lives of everyone, including old age people and person with disabilities . The system’s primary components are a relay, a controller, and an actuator, which operate in concert to detect human presence and activate the door’s opening mechanism. With the help of the integration of IoT technology and voice-based communication technology, users may be able to make their systems run based on voice instructions integrating it with google assistant, as well as utilizing mobile applications. This system is used to streamline the process of granting access to door systems via a phone connected via Wi-Fi. The system has an overall accuracy of 89% and with an average access time of 1.2 second when operated using mobile application and 2.5 seconds when operated using voice instructions.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Computer Vision based Application for Student Monitoring in Classroom
abstract: In this ever-growing field of Artificial Intelligence in which computer vision is a field which is in demand because it can solve a lot of Practical Real-World Problems, we would like to develop an Advanced Live Class Monitoring System. Using this Model, we are aiming to solve real world problems like automated face detection and attendance updating into the database. We would also like to include Real Time Activity Monitoring for detection of Abnormal and Unwanted Activity Detection. This Model would also feature Video Storage and Retrieval Up to Two Days of High Definition Recording, The Video would be only Recorded if there is any activity in a specified area, We would also introduce a feature that is the model would detect if there is any foreign student that is if the student does not belong to a specific class or if he is not a student who has enrolled in a specific subject. Since we have live monitored a respective faculty can watch the live stream in local Personal computer. Considering the Aspects of Security everything is user specific Streaming into local PC. Also, Footage which is uploaded into the cloud which follows Https Protocols is only accessible for Authorized Personnel Only.

articleTitle: A 16×16 Elements Phased Array Transmitter System for MIMO Wireless Communication Systems
abstract: Phased array technique has gained more popularity in Multiple-Input Multiple-Output (MIMO) based wireless communication systems. In this paper, a phased array transmitter consisting of 16×16 isotropic antenna elements is modelled for MIMO applications. The proposed transmitter is modelled at a typical transmitting frequency of 28 GHz in the 5G frequency spectrum. The performance of the transmitter system in terms of 3D beam directivity, 2D phi-cut directivity, 3-dB beamwidth, sidelobe level (SLL) and main lobe power have been analyzed. The effects of window technique and variation in beam scan angle (θ, ϕ) on the directivity and SLL are also reported. Furthermore, the failure performance of the proposed transmitter system has been evaluated statistically using Monte-Carlo analysis. The results reveal that peak mainlobe gain of 25.87 dB and 3-dB beamwidth of 6.28 dB are achieved at θ and ϕ = 0<sup>0</sup>. More than 9 dB reduction in SLL has been realized implementing Taylor window. Furthermore, it is established that the mainlobe directivity is reduced from 26 dB to 22 dB for 50% failure in the antenna elements.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Vehicle Mounted Whip Antennas for HF and VHF Communication
abstract: In this paper, methodical parametric analysis and design of vehicle-mounted whip antennas are presented for HF and VHF communication. For VHF whip antennas, the impacts of variation of the ground plane, antenna height and position, and ground material are investigated. Results indicate that the larger the length of the ground plane, the better is the reflection coefficient, and the vehicle rooftop surface can be used effectively as the ground plane. Antenna height variation from the ground plane indicates that the lower height of the antenna from the ground plane provides better results. Next, the effects of various ground materials are investigated and the performances are found quite similar to each other. Finally, the performance of the designed VHF whip antenna is investigated in several mounting locations on the vehicle. In addition, for HF whip antennas, the bending technique is used for antenna miniaturization and bandwidth enhancement. Here, the roof surface of the vehicle is considered as the ground plane and the antenna is found radiating successfully at desired frequency range. All these findings can be utilized to design customized vehicle-mounted antennas in the HF and VHF frequency bands for secure, faster, and effective communication on the move.

articleTitle: Crop Recommendation with IOT and ML
abstract: The Indian economy heavily depends on agriculture. By recommending a better crop to grow in a certain place, we can increase the production of high-quality yields, but farmers nowadays struggle to choose the crop due to significant climatic and soil condition variations. This project's main objective is to offer the crop that will be most acceptable and suitable given the necessary attributes. The majority of crop losses happen from choosing the wrong crops for a specific area of land. Therefore, we have recommended some fertilization methods that enhance soil nutrient management and boost production. The project includes an Arduino-based hardware kit that provides information on pH, temperature, humidity, and the likelihood of rain by integrating this data on a webpage with a machine learning backend that uses the Random Forest algorithm to estimate crop output.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Analysis of a Low IL MMIC Bandpass Filter for 5G mmwave Applications
abstract: Bandpass filters that are used for mm-wave Monolithic Microwave Integrated Circuit (MMIC) for 5g applications normally comes with high insertion loss (IL). In this project, an analysis and a design of a new improved BPF is being investigated. A low loss BPF using lumped distributed parameter is being designed. In order to achieve a lower insertion loss, improved Q-factor resonator alongside a low-loss coupling topology is used. A Dual-Composite Right Left Handed (D-CRLH) resonator is being used to achieve certain resonant frequency so as to realize mmwave applications. This method gives a new Bandpass filter that can achieve good frequency and have multiple transmission zeroes. The Q-factor of the resonators has been analyzed in order to meet the desired specifications. The MMIC bandpass filter with the new design and topology has been simulated and its parameters have been determined. Instead of the generic PCB designs, here, the GaAs is used as a substrate and the new BPF design is realized. The features from the designed BPF offer parameters which can be suitable for mm-ware 5G communication systems.

articleTitle: A Novel Monopole Antenna for Wideband(Ultra) Wireless Applications with Defected Ground Structure (DGS)
abstract: For Microwave C (4-8 GHz) and X (8-14 GHz) band applications, a wideband monopole antenna with a defective ground structure has been proposed in this paper. With a substrate thickness of 1.6 mm and a low-loss dielectric substrate of Glass Epoxy (FR4) with dielectric constant (ε<inf>r</inf>) of 4.4, a standard printed monopole antenna is designed and simulated with an operating range frequency of center 4.8 GHz. The three square-shaped slots in the ground plane are etched to increase the band width of this monopole antenna. Thorough optimization is used to determine the DGS (Defect Ground Structure) slots. Results from the simulation using the HFSS (High Frequency Structure Simulator) show good radiation pattern and a wide bandwidth with a peak gain of more than 4.8 dBi. In proposed design, a 5 mm semicircle on the patch with edges provides better ultra wideband behavior for the antenna for X band.

articleTitle: Securing Data storage in Cloud after Migration using Immutable Data Dispersion
abstract: Cloud computing has emerged as a technology behemoth with applications in a wide range of fields. When data is being migrated from offline data centres and stored in multiple cloud environments part of the control is always with the Cloud Service Providers(CSPs) leads to security concerns. The data stored in the cloud may sometimes be compromised even though the CSPs may take precautions to avoid such situations. In this paper, we discuss securely storing the data using the data dispersion technique by breaking the data into multiple segments and combining it with encryption along with replication. The division of data and storing it in the cloud helps in protecting the complete data even if an attacker tries to access the data it will not be easy for him to make sense of the retrieved data because the data is already being encrypted and combined with dispersion and replication adds to the complexity of retrieval. Security is achieved as the dispersed data is spread across multiple locations which makes it difficult for an attacker to get all the segments. In most scenarios be able it depends on traditional encryption techniques alone to protect the data. Here, We propose focusing more on how data is stored in the cloud to relieve the system of costly computational methodologies. In this strategy, the trade-off between security and the data retrieval time must also be considered.

articleTitle: Asymmetric Cascaded Switched Diode Multilevel Inverter
abstract: A novel multilevel inverter with asymmetric switching diodes (ASD) is given in this work for medium voltage and high power applications. The full-bridge converter is connected in series to the basic unit to create the designed converter. MATLAB/Simulink is used to simulate an 11-level converter in order to show the suggested multilevel converter’s authority. Finally, waveforms of the output voltage and current are displayed to demonstrate the converter’s dynamic behaviour.

articleTitle: Smart Intelligent System that can Code Like a Human Being
abstract: According to recent studies, a large number of data scientists spend most of their time on tasks like data cleaning and organizing data. They need to memorize big complex syntaxes for all the major tasks in the data science life cycle. Often these tasks are redundant. Therefore, we propose to build an intelligent system that enables data scientists to perform all the tedious and time-consuming tasks such as EDA, data cleansing, data preprocessing, data visualization, modeling, and data science lifecycle evaluation. Just state the logic of your query in natural language the system will automatically output all relevant Python code snippets. Existing applications involving the text-to-code generation and code search are limited and a lot of them do not work in non-ideal conditions. The reason behind it is the data set on which the existing models have been built. These datasets do not consider real-world factors such as slang, acronyms, and paraphrases. Therefore, a new dataset was created consisting of real-world user queries, representing the scenarios a user is most likely to face daily. We plan to build a logic-oriented system that only needs to convey the logic correctly in text in natural language. It saves a lot of time, allowing data scientists to spend most of their time building logic instead of focusing on code.

articleTitle: Analysis of Human Action Recognition Using Machine Learning techniques
abstract: The hand gesture is one of the nonverbal communication strategies used in sign language. Deaf individuals & dumb and have hearing or speech use it most frequently. Communication issues with either one another or with regular individuals. Many sign language systems have been created by different makers, but they're not very useful or affordable for deaf or hard of hearing persons. So, the software has a prototype that can automatically detect signs to assist deaf and dumb persons in communicating with each other and with other people more easily. The majority of individuals find it challenging to comprehend and communicate with others who are deaf or mute, so they're usually denied regular social interaction. These individuals are dependent on an using an interpreter or a visual medium of communication.<sup>[1]</sup> An There won't always be an interpreter present, and visual communication is mainly challenging to comprehend The main language is sign language a method of communication for the population of the deaf and dumb. As a the grammar and meaning of numerous words are unknown to the average person. the hand gestures that make up a sign language, which are mostly their relatives and/or the community of the deaf and dumb.<sup>[2]</sup>

articleTitle: Distributed Cluster Storage Technology of Massive Remote Sensing Data
abstract: With the rapid development of remote sensing information science and technology and computer Internet technology, remote sensing applications in various fields continue to expand and deepen. Remote sensing data is gradually developing towards global coverage, multiple data sources, multiple spatial resolutions and multi temporal spatial characteristics, and the amount of data is growing explosively. In this case, how to realize the rapid distribution and sharing services of massive remote sensing data has become an extremely concerned issue in the field of Remote Sensing Science and technology and remote sensing application departments. This paper studies the distributed cluster storage technology of massive remote sensing data and its application in the field of remote sensing. The research results will be used to develop a new generation of distributed cluster storage system, which can support large amounts of data, high-speed access and low cost.

articleTitle: ServiceArc: A Systematic Approach towards Daily Wage Labour Management through Automation System
abstract: Daily wage labourers and workers are an integral part of the economy of any country. Especially in a country like India where the estimated population of daily wage workers is nearly around 187 million, they are the backbone of our economy. The problem here is that a lot of workers are financially exploited by contractors who are able to take advantage of the helplessness of the labour who need to find work every single day. In order to tackle this issue, the proposed system aims to establish a meeting point between the labour, contractors, and customers. Therefore, we are designing and implementing an Android application for the purpose of enabling daily wage labour and workers to connect with their customers and contractors and facilitate a fully-fledged platform for end users to obtain their services. Upon registration on the application, the labour can directly come in contact with customers by making themselves available and thus provide their services. The users can also obtain services through the contractor in case multiple labours are required by them. Multi-lingual support, GPS, standard prices, a payment interface, and a rating system are some of the key features of the application.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Openairinterface's Scheduling Algorithms for 5G Networks
abstract: The introduction of the fifth generation (5G) of mobile networks (5G) has showed how crucial enhanced scheduling approaches are managing the scarce frequency spectrum whereas meeting 5G transmission needs. Openairinterface (OAI) simulation environment helps the researcher to analyses various components of 4G/5G Networks. In this paper, performance of 5G mobile network is analyzed by comparing the results with 5G scheduler algorithms available in OAI in terms of throughput. offered by openairinterface to check the performance. Simulated OAI environment consists of UE and gNodeB (gNB). The pcap file is generated and analyzed using Wireshark. The results show how schedulers allocated resources to UE from gNodeB (gNB) and throughput is the performance metric used to analyze. Resource allocation using Round Robin at UE gives uniform throughput compare to first in first out based resource allocation.

articleTitle: Design, Modeling and Analysis of 2×2 Microstrp Patch Antenna Array System for 5G Applications
abstract: This study presents the design, mathematical modeling, and analysis of a 2×2 microstrip patch antenna array (MSPA) for 5G applications operating at 5.3 GHz. The proposed array employs a small strip antenna module with two vertical slots, and is based on phased array antenna systems (PAAS), which are widely used in both defense radar and commercial applications. The microstrip patch antenna is designed using Ansys HFSS simulation tool, and features slot arrays for linear polarization parallel and perpendicular to the axis. The antenna is fed through transverse slots in the wide wall of the circular waveguide and fed through longitudinal slots in the small wall of the rectangular waveguide. The single MSPA achieves a maximum gain of 6.14 dB at 5.3 GHz, while the 2×2 array structure produces a gain of 7.713 dB at the same frequency. The results demonstrate the potential for such antennas in 5G technology and devices.

articleTitle: Brain Disease Classification along with Age Estimation from MRI
abstract: Deep neural networks can effectively be used to predict the type of brain disease caused to the patient and to estimate the age of the patient. This can be used for identifying the age related disorders. So, we are using MobileNet a machine learning algorithm, and Res Net deep convolutional neural network, by using transfer learning. In transfer learning these models are pre trained on larger data sets. These algorithms have been used to train brain MRI scans that have been divided into three classes [1] Normal, which has not been affected by any disease, [2] Mild Cognitive Impairment, and [3] Alzheimer disease. From the categorized photographs the age of the patient is determined easily. We are going to train our model by using MOBILENET and RESNET algorithms by using the dataset of MRI images along with the accompanying disease type.By using this knowledge, the model may identify patterns in the MRI data that point to particular brain illnesses and patient age. The trained model is further used to find the disease type and age of the patients. The outcomes demonstrate that the technique is capable of achieving high accuracy in tasks involving both disease categorization and age estimation. In general, the suggested techniques for categorizing brain disorders and determining age from MRI scans offer a viable answer for enhancing the effectiveness and precision of medical diagnosis and treatment planning for patients with brain diseases. By this model we can predict results in larger scale real time data in short period of time.

articleTitle: Compact sized Step-cut Antenna for 5G Applications
abstract: Microstrip patch antennas with enhanced bandwidth and radiation efficiency are becoming increasingly important in the development of 5G wireless communication systems. With the ever- growing demand for high-speed data transfer, 5G technology promises to revolutionize the way people connect to the internet and communicate with each other. However, the implementation of 5G networks requires a significant increase in the number of base stations, which creates challenges in terms of space limitations and cost. Microstrip patch antennas with Step-cut can provide an effective solution to these challenges by offering a compact, low- cost, and high- performance antenna design. A Step-cut microstrip patch antenna, suitable for 5G applications, is proposed and designed. The substrates in the suggested antenna measure a height of 1.6 mm, a width of 20 mm, and a length of 16 mm. The patch is 12x8 mm in size. The S-parameters, gain, return loss, electric field distribution, directivity is analyzed. A useful antenna development can improve overall performance.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Enhanced DV-Hop algorithm in Wireless Sensor Network
abstract: The location of sensors is essential for the vast majority of WSN applications. We need localization schemes in WSNs to obtain where the information is obtaining Sensor nodes’ geo- graphical positions are determined using localization techniques. Sensor node position is advantageous for many network management operations such as routing, topology control, and security maintenance. The distance vector hop (DV-Hop) localization technique is a prominent approach in which dumb nodes collect information from anchor nodes to calculate coordinates, resulting in a high localization error. While calculating the hop value, multiple communication radii are used. A weighted centroid algorithm based on DV-hop decreases the localization error and computational cost. Flooding is limited up to t hops to lower energy consumption. Regarding localization error it decreases 50% of error, power consumption, and computational cost, simulation results and theoretical analysis show that the suggested enhance approach achieves higher accuracy than the traditional DV-Hop algorithm.

articleTitle: Structure Design of Picking Robot based on Crowd Optimization Algorithm
abstract: The structure design of picking robot based on crowd optimization algorithm is a multi-objective optimization problem. The objective function consists of two objectives: the first is to maximize profit and the second is to minimize total cost. In this paper, we focus on maximizing profit by considering labor costs and material costs to achieve maximum production efficiency. Generally, there are three different types of picking robots: picker type, gripper type and double gripper type. The main idea of this method is that we can use people as intelligent workers, who will complete all the work of picking up objects for us. Therefore, we don't need to spend a lot of money and time on building our own robots or machines, but just let people help us easily complete our work.

articleTitle: Enhancing Urban Living - A Comprehensive Solution Using Machine Learning and IoT
abstract: The urban population is increasing rapidly, leading to challenges in managing daily life activities such as transportation, healthcare, and accessing local services. The developed "At a Glance," is a comprehensive mobile application and digital billboard that provides real-time solutions to several problems faced by city dwellers. The app uses machine learning and IoT to offer features such as real-time traffic monitoring, local news updates, resource people contacts, medical and health information, among others. It aims to promote sustainable living, reduce traffic congestion and air pollution, and make the city a better place to live. "At a Glance" uses various technologies such as Flutter, Firebase Realtime Database and Storage, TensorFlow, IoT, geolocator, geocoder, OpenStreetMaps, and Raspberry Pi. The app offers features such as traffic density monitoring, real-time weather updates, local news and event notifications, and a resource people directory. The app also uses machine learning algorithms to recommend relevant services and resources to users based on their preferences. "At a Glance" has the potential to revolutionize urban living by providing a one-stop solution for all daily life activities. The app can help people make informed decisions, save time and resources, and reduce their carbon footprint. The app's user-friendly interface and accessibility make it a promising solution for cities worldwide.

articleTitle: Data Validation for Eligibility Criteria and Death Benefit Claims for Insurance Policies
abstract: To manage the daily operations of auditing new insurance applicant data, insurance companies rely on their legacy insurance systems which involves working with excel sheets, DOS application software and multiple data sources. This auditing system functions in compliance with the rules and conditions specified in File and Use (F&U) documentation, which is present in different formats on different systems. This system also entails the manual process of calculations and verification of the values with F&U specifications. This manual technique is labour-intensive and error-prone, while also increasing the risk of inconsistencies in the policy auditing systems. Insurance companies are aiming to replace this obsolete legacy system with more contemporary software systems. Our software aims to automate this process of user policy data verification and validation while also providing a simple user interface for the company staff to work with and get actionable results.

articleTitle: UAV Swarm Navigation in GNSS Denied Region with Formation Control
abstract: UAVs are becoming extremely essential these days for many applications such as HADR missions. During these missions, there can be a loss of GPS signal due to challenging environments and terrains, and this can hinder the missions so there is a need for a system that provides UAVs the capability to do these missions even in GPS-denied environments. In most of such missions, swarms of UAVs are working. Hence, the aim of this research paper is to propose a reliable GPS-denied navigation system for swarms. The major challenge with the swarm navigation is to achieve inter-UAV collision avoidance. So, this paper mainly focuses on prevention of inter UAV collision. Therefore, to accomplish this objective, the integration of estimations by Visual Odometry and UWB module is proposed in this paper.

articleTitle: Experimental Validation of Space Vector-based PWM Technique for 3l-VSI
abstract: In this paper, some important aspects related to operating modes, dead time in inverter switches, merits, demerits and PWM technique implementation of controlled diode bridge clamped-based 3L-VSI are discussed in detail. A high-frequency PWM technique based on the principle of the space vector concept is used for the analysis of switching states. Two main types of switching techniques based on the space vector approach namely, continuous and discontinuous PWM techniques have been used. For the discontinuous PWM sequence, the main focus here is to accurately select the switching sequence for the first switching cycle so that the nearest three-level switching can be achieved without any extra switching instant over a fundamental cycle of the output voltage. The dependence of the modulation index on switching states selection has been pointed out. To verify the correctness of the proposed approach, simulation and experimental results are presented.

articleTitle: Simulation of Comparative Analysis Of Maximum Power Point Tracking Techniques for Photo Voltaic System
abstract: This article simulates the three maximum power point tracking (MPPT) techniques for photovoltaic (PV) systems: PO, cumulative conductance, and fuzzy logic. The simulation is done in a number of weather scenarios, including clear, partly hazy, and overcast skies, using MATLAB/Simulink. Performance metrics for each technique are efficiency, reaction time, tracking accuracy, and steadystate performance. The data is quantita- tively evaluated using ANOVA to find significant changes in the performance of the strategies. The computer results show that incremental conductance outperforms the other methods when the sky is clear, whereas fuzzy logic outperforms them when the sky is partly foggy and overcast.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Intelligent Technology in Electrical Automatic Control Engineering
abstract: The application research of intelligent technology in electrical automatic control engineering is a research field to study the development and application of intelligent technology in electrical automatic control engineering. It also focuses on the development and application of artificial intelligence (AI) in this field, which is an important part of modern power system automation. The main focus areas include: high-speed circuit design, fault detection and isolation, smart grid management, distributed energy resource management, energy storage system and renewable energy system. The main challenge for researchers is to develop new algorithms to solve complex problems faster than traditional methods; Improve existing solutions to make them more efficient; It includes the research of intelligent control, artificial intelligence and machine learning, fuzzy logic, neural network and evolutionary computation. The main goal of this research is to develop an intelligent system for controlling processes or equipment with high accuracy and efficiency.

articleTitle: Web App For Predicting Fake Job Posts Using Ensemble Classifiers
abstract: Taking advantage of the internet, cheating people online has become common these days, there are numerous types of scams done online, employment scam is one of them, where fake job postings are published online to attract people who are unemployed and looking for work. By becoming victims of these fake job postings, many people lose their personal information and money. This needs to be dealt with intelligence and caution. In this paper, we have proposed a comparative study using different ensemble classifiers which work effectively on this problem and help to predict whether a particular job is genuine or fake. We have used five different ensemble classifiers: Random Forest, LightGBM, XGboost, Catboost, and Extra tree. EMSCAD(Employment Scam Aegean Dataset) which contains 17880 job posts is used to train the models. We have created a web application to make it further easy for users to take advantage of this facility. XGBoost classifier has achieved 96.8% accuracy. which is highest among other classifiers also it was observed that the Light GBM classifier is faster than the other classifiers.

articleTitle: Classification of EMG Signals for Myoelectric Prosthesis with Feature Images
abstract: Accurate hand movement recognition using electromyography (EMG) data is crucial for creating a reliable human-machine interface system for prosthesis control. Proper feature selection from EMG signals is required for the precise recognition and classification of various movements. In this regard, we proposed a classification scheme that improves classi- fication accuracy. This work focuses on the classification of EMG signals for hand prostheses by using sEMG feature images which are further fed into a simple CNN network. Some commonly used time-domain features such as Root Mean Square(RMS), Mean Absolute Variance(MAV), integral Absolute Variance(IAV), Slope Sign Changes(SSC), and Waveform Length(WL) are utilized in this research. The features are converted into images, further fed into the CNN network for classification. We utilized hand gestures of the benchmark datasets NinaPro DB1 and obtained a classification accuracy of 91.2%.

articleTitle: Economic Load Dispatch Using Machine Learning
abstract: Economic Load Dispatch (ELD) is an important task in power system optimization, which aims to allocate the generation power of each unit in the power system to meet the demand at minimum cost. Accurate prediction of the load sharing and cost can assist in the effective planning and management of power systems. This paper presents a web application that predicts the load sharing and cost using Machine Learning .In this study, a novel approach that combines an Optimazation algorithm(OA) and Machine Learning (ML)considering Load requirements and Operating conditions to optimize data .A decision tree regressor algorithm is employed as ML and a Lagrangian Multiplier(LM) is used as an OA. The prediction in this technique involves 3 and 6 Generating Units. The web application is designed to be user-friendly and accessible, allowing users to input data and get predictions in real-time. The application can be used by power system planners and operators to optimize their systems and reduce costs.

articleTitle: Self Power Generation in Electric Vehicles using Driving Wheel
abstract: This paper contributes the design and development of self charging DC motor based electric vehicles. It is also known as self power generating vehicles. It consists of a four gear DC motor, a charging unit and two batteries. A driving wheel of the vehicle coupled to the DC motor and received the torque from the displacement of the driving wheel. The charging unit converts the torque into electrical energy and electrochemical energy stored in the battery. The motor is configured to adapt the electrical energy from the battery into torque this will provide to the driving wheel to displace the vehicle. The hardware prototype of the self charging electric vehicle model was developed and demonstrated the performance of the drive system in the laboratory. The proposed model is more eco friendly and easy to drive. The future of the electric vehicle system is based on the lithium ion battery, low cost system, wide range of drive and self charging system.

articleTitle: Biometric Authentication using ECG Signals
abstract: An electrocardiogram commonly called ECG or EKG is an electrical signal from the heart which is generally used to monitor the health of the heart. Due to its highly discriminatory property, ECG-based authentication has recently achieved great attention. However, there are still many challenges in discriminatory feature extraction and efficient pattern classification presented in the state of the arts and various research studies. We initially removed the noise from the ECG signals consisting of noise components of high and low frequencies with the help of the moving average filter. The process of extracting necessary parts of the input signals which contain discriminatory information related to each individual is performed by use of the Empirical Mode Decomposition method. Thereafter the feature extraction is carried out with the features of the statistical domain, time domain, and frequency domain taken from the decomposed signals of ECG data. The classification is done using the selected features from ECG signals data with various algorithms for biometric authentication to know the accuracy and performance of each method and for choosing the most effective classification.

articleTitle: An Efficient Ridesharing Model using Machine Learning Based on Riders Reviews
abstract: It is now more important than ever to take action to lessen the negative consequences of private vehicles. If successfully implemented, mass transit is the ideal option, however because of its lack of door-to-door service, lengthier fixed routes, and unreliable timetable, many people do not appreciate it. Therefore, new facilities or services should be created to offer users a comfortable and dependable service and to lessen potentially dangerous environmental effects like pollution, congestion, etc. One of the cutting-edge technologies that is being used all over the world is ride sharing, in which users who have the same origin-destination and journey time are matched and share the transport. To help in implementation of ride sharing, a mobile application is being developed using machine learning techniques such as the Naïve Bayes algorithms to match users based on their travel preferences and habits. The app will provide a more personalized and convenient service to the users, ensuring that they are matched with the most suitable carpool partners.

articleTitle: An Effective Smart Goggle to Address the Problem Faced by the Visually Impaired People
abstract: According to our research and the studies, there are around 4.95 million people who are blind and at the same time70 million people who are partially visually impaired in India. Without vision, it becomes difficult for the blind people to find their way without encountering obstacles. Avoiding obstacles can be uncomfortable, clumsy, and inaccurate, even with aids such as walking sticks. People with vision or vision problems have to deal with multiple issues in their daily lives, as modern assistive devices often do not meet consumer needs in terms of price and level of support. Our project presents a new design of assistive glasses for the visually impaired person. It is intended to assist in multiple daily tasks utilizing a portable design format. The overall build cost is kept low by using a Raspberry Pi 4 single board computer for processing and a camera for image acquisition. Our proposed glasses use Machine Learning (ML) to extract information from images and verbally communicate what the wearer is seeing through the audio output. As a result, ML-enabled glasses enable blind and partially sighted users to find personal items at home, read documents at workplace, take public transportation without any overhead, recognize friends, and many more such applications, can make them more independent, freer, and more aware of their surroundings. We made use of YOLOv3 algorithm for object detection and got the accuracy of 94.3% and which was able to detect majority of the objects in the surroundings of the user.

articleTitle: Indoor Violence Detection using Lightweight Transformer Model
abstract: Human activity recognition from surveillance videos is an active research area in Computer Vision and Machine Learning. The detection of indoor violent activities is a major challenge in the surveillance sector due to the lack of sufficient indoor footage, and the presence of obstacles inducing occlusions in a household environment. Several studies on the topic of violence detection have been done, with the best performing models using Convolutional Neural Networks for spatial feature learning, followed by a Recurrent Neural Network variant for temporal feature learning. Recent studies suggest that Vision Transformers have a better run-time and are more robust to partial occlusions than their deep convolutional network counterparts. In this paper, we present a light-weight transformer model, drawing upon the recent success of video vision transformers in action recognition. The model extracts spatial features from the input frames, and adds temporal relation to the selected frames with the help of tubelet embedding, which are then encoded using various transformer layers. Generally, although transformer models are shown to need extensive training on large datasets, it has been proven that using efficient preprocessing, we can train the model on comparatively small sized datasets. The light-weight model has achieved an accuracy of 88.24% on our self-curated indoor violence dataset and a 98% accuracy on a subset containing videos in which the subjects involved in the activity are occluded from view.

articleTitle: Encrypted Instant Messaging Service Using XMPP Protocol
abstract: Instant messaging enables real-time contact between users, which is increasingly becoming a part of everyday life since it is quicker and more effective. In general, instant messaging systems and the protocols that enable them , the security measures necessary to protect the integrity, confidentiality, and authenticity of the message is not likely reliable. In this approach, a solution is offered by fusing cryptography and hashing methods with instant messaging for Extensible Messaging and Presence Protocol-equipped devices (XMPP). A single user or a group of users may get simultaneous presence notifications from the XMPP server. By developing a framework that allows several users to communicate concurrently, the server makes personal and group chats available. The suggested structure was developed for encrypting the messages end to end and these messages are authenticated using hashing technique.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Physical Layer of Peripheral Component Interconnect Express (PCIe) Protocol
abstract: PCIe is a communication protocol which is widely used VLSI industry for various applications like desktop, mobile, embedded computing, communication platform and many more. The data transfer between receiver and transmitter in this protocol happens in form of packets. Packet travel from transaction layer then to data link layer after that it goes to physical layer vice versa for receiver side. In this paper physical layer is on focus. Physical layer contains three important modules scrambler/descrambler,8bto10b encoder/decoder and parallel-to-serial and serial-to-parallel. In this paper design of each of the above modules is done using Verilog in Quartus Intel and verification is done on Modelsim.

articleTitle: Classification of Plant Species based Seedlings and Weedlings in Low Lightening Conditions using Deep Convolution Neural Network
abstract: Smart farming techniques involve the use of plant identification and classification. Deep learning can be particularly useful for classifying low-light images because it can impulsively learn features from the data that can be relevant for classification. This is especially important in low light conditions where the image may be noisy or contain artefacts that are not relevant to the task. In the experiment, the plant seedlings and weedlings dataset consisting of low light images are subjected to a deep-learning model. Low-light images tend to have poor image quality due to the limited amount of available light. This results in a very low signal-to-noise ratio, making extracting beneficial information from the images extremely ambiguous. In the proposed work, a deep learning XceptionNet model is utilized to perform classification of plants using seedlings and weedlings that provides performance yielding an accuracy of 94.13% with 25 epochs.

articleTitle: A Comparative Analysis of Real-time Crash and Fall Detection Mechanisms based on sensor-fusion, aural inputs, and visual recognition techniques
abstract: Fall and crashes can have serious consequences to people of all ages, making the development of crash and fall detection systems a critical area of research. This survey paper aims to provide a overall view of the current trends pertaining to the field related to fall detection mechanisms and sound-based car crash detection. We have discussed about recent researches in the domain, with varied approaches to fall and crash detection systems. We analyze each system's architectural design, datasets, accuracy, and limitations. We also compare and contrast the different approaches and discuss future research directions. The results of this survey research paper will help form a basis for future research in the fall and crash detection domains and further contribute to developing effective algorithms for related prevention measures.

articleTitle: A High-Gain Dual-Band Antenna based on SISL Platform using Characteristic Mode Analysis
abstract: A simple dual-band circular patch antenna for C-band fixed satellite communication based on a substrate-integrated suspended line (SISL) platform applying characteristic mode analysis (CMA) is presented in this paper. A pair of radial slots with an angular separation is utilised to achieve the dual-band operation. The antenna yields a fractional impedance bandwidth of 2.14% (4.62-4.72) GHz and 6.4% (6.66- 7.1 GHz). The embedded cavity achieves high gain, high radiation efficiency and low-cost design in the five-layer platform. Moreover, it is a self-packaged multilayered structure. The maximum realized gains are 7.63 and 10.13 dBi at 4.67 GHz and 6.88 GHz, respectively. The radiation efficiencies in respective bands are higher than 85% and 94%, and the antenna exhibits stable boresight radiation in both rounds of operation.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Microstrip Patch Antenna for Communication between Pilot and Air Traffic Controller
abstract: Aeronautical communication between pilots and Air Traffic Control is crucial to preventing aircraft accidents. Ground-based augmentation systems (GBAS) and VHF communications services are operated in the 117-137 MHz band in aeronautical communication systems. The goal of this project is to develop a low profile microstrip patch antenna that will replace the existing VHF antenna while minimizing its size, mass, and cost. With this project, VHF Air to Ground(A/G) communication is our primary goal. Weather and navigational information are sent via VHF A/G communications, which also include conversations between ATC and aircraft in the air. A software named High Frequency Structure Simulator (HFSS) is used to simulate the designed antenna. Here, the substrate for the antenna is made of FR4 Epoxy and measures 350 mm by 170 mm. Several strategies were used in this research to achieve the target aerial characteristics. The antenna dimension is decreased using the meander line method. The research made use of hexagonal ring-shaped defective ground system (DGS) methods for improving bandwidth impedance and microstrip line feed, as well as single stub approaches to achieve optimum antenna impedance matching. The antenna’s operating frequency of 127 MHz and -25.7 dB reflection coefficient support the performance of aviation communications on the given frequency range. These techniques have been studied and acquired.

articleTitle: Dance Movement Recognition Technology Based on Multi Feature Fusion
abstract: The research on dance movement recognition technology based on multi feature fusion is a research aimed at developing a system that can recognize human movements in real time. The study will help people with disabilities and others who have difficulty moving their bodies perform daily tasks, such as walking, dancing or sports. Researchers are trying to build a computer program that can recognize the movement patterns of people with dyskinesia. The goal is to enable the software to detect and analyze specific movements so that it can help guide someone through activities they may not be able to move freely. It also allows them to better control their behavior.

articleTitle: OghmaNano Simulation of PM6:D18:L8-BO Organic Solar Cell and Comparison with other Lesser Efficient Solar Cells
