abstract: The deteriorating environmental conditions and the need for environmentally safe products and low cost and constantly increasing efficiency has led to the growing research in organic solar cells but the low efficiency of these organic solar cells has been a challenge. Organic solar cells have many advantages but due to its low power efficiency the commercialization is difficult. Organic solar cells are made up of multilayer components made up of organic materials mostly polymer based. The objective of this research is to increase the efficiency of PM6:D18:L8-BO organic solar cell and compare it in multiple aspects with various lower efficiency organic solar cells like "D18:L8-BO", "P3HT:PCBM", "PM6:L8-BO" solar cells.

articleTitle: Identification Model of Electronic Music Signal based on Optimization Group Algorithm
abstract: As the basic component of music recognition and music information recording and retrieval, the recognition and estimation of music signals and the recording and retrieval of music signals have attracted more and more attention of relevant researchers. The diversity of music signals determines the complexity and difficulty of music signal recognition. The recognition model of electronic music signal is a method to extract music information from input audio signal. The purpose of this process is to identify the music content in the audio signal and extract the music content from the original sound. In this case, we can say that identifying music content means finding out the type of instrument played in the track or which music style it belongs to. This process is also called extraction because it extracts something from another thing (in our case, sound). In order to recognize electronic music signals, we need some preprocessing steps before starting the recognition algorithm. This process is based on an optimization algorithm, also known as an optimization group algorithm. The basic concept of this recognition method is as follows: input data consists of two signals, one of which contains all information about tone (frequency), and the other contains information about amplitude (volume). The output signal will contain only frequency components and no other components. To achieve this goal, we need to find out how much energy each component has in the input data by using optimization algorithms (such as newton).

articleTitle: Detection of Cyber – Attacks in Digital Power System Using Ensemble Bagged Trees
abstract: Selection of algorithm is vital for the proper detection of Cyber-attacks in digital Power systems. Power systems are developing from pure physical systems into cyber – physical systems which makes them more vulnerable to cyber-attacks. Because of the wide range applications of this cyber systems in power systems it is challenging to stop these attacks. In this paper ensemble bagged tree is proposed for the real time detection of a fault and attack with acceptable accuracy. This proposed framework is based on the data from the Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) and relays under normal, fault and cyber-attack conditions. The performance of the proposed algorithm is validated in MATLAB/Simulink test bed and compared with other machine learning algorithms in this paper.

articleTitle: Detecting Sarcasm in Reddit Comments: A Comparative Analysis
abstract: Sarcasm is the use of sarcastic words to mock or mockingly show disdain for something. Several people frequently use it on social media sites like Reddit and Twitter. This study investigates the effectiveness of deep learning and machine learning algorithms in detecting sarcasm using SARC dataset consisting of 1.3 million Reddit comments with almost equal amounts of sarcastic and neutral comments. We compare several well-known machine learning classification methods, including Logistic Regression, Naïve Bayes, Decision Tree Classifier, and Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN). Our results, with an accuracy of 73.2%, demonstrate that the model designed using a fusion of CNN and Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM) techniques performed better than alternative classification algorithms. Our findings show how machine learning techniques will be used in the future to identify sarcasm on social networking websites.

articleTitle: Real-time Recognition of Indian Sign Language using OpenCV and Deep Learning
abstract: Sign language is a mechanism that uses hand gestures to facilitate communication between individuals with speaking or hearing impairments. Real-time sign language recognition provides a medium of communication between the general public and those who have difficulty with hearing or speaking. Different kinds of models are developed to provide a feasible solution for this problem. But the traditional models are either expensive or not customizable with limited gestures. In order to address this issue, a model has been developed that can recognize the sign language gestures immediately in real-time. This robust model provides an efficient way to recognize Indian Sign language (ISL) signs dynamically. The dataset is created in a customized manner to include ten phrases that convey comprehensive meaning. The captured data is augmented to identify gestures with different variations. A convolutional neural network has been employed to build the model and perform the multi-class classification on image data. The proposed model recognizes person’s gesture and provides a text output. The results and observations demonstrate that the model identifies a person’s signs accurately and efficiently in real-time. The customized model provides various advantages as new gestures can be added according to the requirement. The improvements suggest various methods that can be leveraged to upgrade the model.

articleTitle: Study and Analyzing Propagation Models for Wireless Mesh Networks
abstract: The invention of wireless mesh networks (WMN) is inside the center of attention of instructional research to offerings and Internets connectivity’s. A WMN is also considered be a wireless multi hop community which consists of routers and clients in mesh pattern. The routers in the mesh pattern have minimal mobility and structure that like of a rear bone which presents entry to the mesh clients of the wireless mesh community. A number of out-doors propagation fashions are proposed for the lookup routing for this purpose. Furthermore, solely a few fashions are taken underneath consideration for the performances of routing metrics by means of thinking about special node densities. The simple propagation mechanisms are equal regarded in the overall performance of the conversation systems. Amongst major problems in routing is to supplying pleasant overall performance whilst scaling the wireless mesh network.

articleTitle: Highway Tunnel Environment Perception System Based on Internet of Things and Cloud Computing Technology
abstract: This paper studies the highway tunnel environment awareness system based on the Internet of Things and cloud computing technology. The system is based on Internet of Things and cloud computing technology. It can be used to detect objects, people and vehicles in highway tunnels. The system can also provide real-time information about traffic flow, road conditions and weather conditions in the tunnel. It provides decision data for government officials, engineers and maintenance personnel. The measured results show that the system has high integration, simple layout and stable operation, which makes up for the technical defects of single collection content of portable tunnel monitoring equipment, insufficient data accuracy and complex structure and decentralized layout of traditional fixed tunnel monitoring facilities.

articleTitle: Control Strategy for DC to DC Converter using MLP embedded Actor-Critic Architecture
abstract: Buck-boost DC to DC converters find a huge application in the industry for acquiring a constant DC output voltage. Due to the instability issues caused by the constant power loads, there has always been a requirement for adaptive control strategies that shall control and hence stabilize the voltage. In this paper, we have proposed an enhanced multilayered perceptron embedded in the actor-critic architecture to control the voltage variations. A PPO-based tuner consisting of the MLP has been used which produces coefficients that can be fed directly to our closed-loop feedback controller for the self-adaptive control system. The input and output sets have been analyzed along with appropriate hyperparameter tuning of the neural network within. Considering the seasonality of the data distribution of the input voltage, an appropriate training method has been used, ensuring the optimal real-time performance of the controller.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Hybrid Optimization-based Feature Selection for Sentiment Analysis
abstract: Reviews, ratings, and texts that customers have made online on items they have purchased online. These assessments assist business owners to assess their strengths and flaws and take action. The company owner cannot track each review due to the large volume of reviews. Recently, sentiment analysis for review summarization has demanded techniques from massive datasets. The sentiment analysis from the raw texts becomes a challenging task that needs to optimized feature selection approach. Using Natural Language Processing, the pre-processing step must eliminate the undesirable material from the text reviews (NLP). The extraction of more significant and reliable features for accurate sentiment analysis was the focus of the feature extraction phase. To that end, we present the Hybrid Multi-objective Optimization (HMO) method, which combines Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) with the Krill Herd Algorithm (KHA). The HMO selects features from the supplied pre-processed reviews. The classification is performed by using different machine learning classifiers. The simulation results prove the efficiency of the proposed model compared to the existing solutions in terms of precision, recall, F1 score, and execution time.

articleTitle: A Coherent Way of Detecting Learner’s Academic Emotions via Live Camera Using CNN and Deep LSTM
abstract: Academic Emotion Detection is fundamentally a system for detecting emotions. The system's main goal was to identify feelings expressed while attending online lectures during the COVID-19 epidemic. The topic Academic Emotion Detection using Machine Learning focuses on utilizing machine learning and deep learning to identify human face emotions in light of the shift to online learning.Our research has a limited scope, it focuses on four academic emotions: confusion, boredom, engagement, and frustration. A person may experience a wide range of other emotions as well. Here, we have used CNN and Deep LSTM for the prediction of said four emotions and it has been observed it increases the accuracy of prediction and effectiveness. We even incorporated a portion of a questionnaire into our research to compare our results with genuine human experiences.Concurrent Neural Network (CNN), Long-Short Term Memory (LSTM), and Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) are three different algorithms from the deep learning area that we have used in this study to examine how they operate and identify similarities and differences.

articleTitle: EEG Based Decision Selection System Using Deep Learning
abstract: There are more than 1.2 billion physically challenged people in the globe. They are reliant on other people to communicate their ideas. They could become more autonomous with the aid of a brain-controlled typing device. Our project's major goal is to make it easier for those who are physically impaired to express their decisions on their own without the assistance of others. In this paper, we trained a deep learning model that combines the advantages of both convolutional and a recurrent neural network by taking an input EEG dataset which was collected using a dataset obtained from Physio Net online database. We have trained the deep learning model in order to display the decisions selected in the form of text which are left, down, right, up. This model would be a great help to the people with physical challenges. Further we can develop a separate GUI which can make the model more interactive and simple to use.

articleTitle: An Efficient and Low Power 45nm CMOS Based R-2R DAC
abstract: The main purpose of the Digital to Analog converter (DAC) is to act as an interface between the digital device and the analog device. Which converts the binary digital values(0,1) into a series of analog voltages. Each type of DAC has its own set of advantages and disadvantages, It is not possible to attain all positive aspects in one circuit. By considering different parameters like power, resolution etc., we have designed a 4-bit CMOS based R-2R DAC in 45nm technology. In this paper, we are using two stage operational amplifier(opamp) in order to enhance the performance of the R-2R DAC. A differential amplifier stage and a gain stage form the two stage opamp, and two values of resistors R and 2R are invoked to form the R-2R ladder network. This two stage opamp and 4-bit R-2R ladder network are used together to design a 4-bit R-2R DAC. Then This DAC is simulated using the Synopsys H-spice tool and based on the simulation results, analysis is performed by considering various parameters like accuracy-Integral nonlinearity (INL) and Differential nonlinearity(DNL) errors, resolution, average, static, and dynamic powers, and settling time. The proposed R-2R DAC has low power and less INL, and DNL errors which are efficient when compared with the related work.

articleTitle: Terminal sliding mode controller for Magnetic Levitation system using Particle Swarm Optimization
abstract: This proposed paper briefs the design of a terminal sliding mode controller (TSMC) which is known for faster time convergence and high robustness. This proposed controller scheme is for a magnetic levitation system to control the position of the ball. The non-linear model of a magnetic levitation system consists of mechanical and electrical units that are taken into account. In this scheme, the TSMC switching surface contains integration and fraction to error variables. The terminal switching surface contains designed parameters and these parameters can be obtained with the help of particle swarm optimization (PSO). This controller scheme provides chattering less response, less control input effort and faster response convergence. The TSMC has been compared with a conventional Sliding mode control regarding the chattering effect in control input and settling time. The TSMC is designed to attain high robustness against disturbances and parameter variations The simulations are included for authenticating the adequacy of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Stock Market Price Prediction Using Machine Learning Techniques
abstract: The goal of the paper is to analyse real-time stock market data values as they change over time. A difficult task in research is predicting and analysing future stock values. The necessity to create an automated, computational approach for forecasting stock market data values, which fluctuate depending on the degree of risk, is what spurred this research’s development. currently in this an automated approach is not available the researcher used historical data from past along with stock market professionals to find a good prediction.A comparative study for stock market prediction is on in this paper using lstm and rnn the dataset we have used from yahoo finance where day to day the dataset is updated this ml method gives a better accuracy rate.

articleTitle: Multi Lung Disease Detection
abstract: The user’s disease is predicted via a multi disease prediction system based on predictive modelling using the symptoms they offer as input. The user's symptoms are evaluated by the algorithm, which then outputs the possibility that the condition will manifest itself. Disease Different classifiers are used for prediction, and we also use 6 illnesses and various machine learning and deep learning algorithms. The proposed technique has a higher accuracy, and we construct a web allocation for prediction system.The Existing work has only differentiated 3 diseases with 4 classes with only deep learning techniques but our proposed can classify 6 diseases with 7 classes with both machine learning and deep learning algorithms.

articleTitle: Application of Analytical Computer Science and Technology in Data Management
abstract: The application of analytical computer science and technology in data management is a part of analytical computer science and technology. It mainly involves data management, data mining, information retrieval, text mining, etc. This course will help you understand how to use computers to solve problems related to data analysis. You will learn about the different techniques you can use when analyzing large amounts of data, such as clustering, regression analysis, classification, etc. The main purpose of this course is to let students understand various tools available in the market for analyzing large amounts of data from various sources (such as web logs or databases).

articleTitle: An Extensive Review on SISL-based Antennas with Hexagonal Shaped SISL-Antenna
abstract: Substrate-integrated suspended line (SISL) is a quasi-planar, multi-layered platform for designing antennas with embedded cavities. The SISL antenna shows good radiation performance, low loss, and self-packaging characteristics, which are more suitable for modern communication systems. A SISL-based hexagonal patch antenna, different types of SISL-based antennas in the literature, their advantages, and their performance are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: Speech to Text App Customized for Police Functioning in Different Languages
abstract: One of the important fields in Natural Language Processing (NLP) is Speech-to-text (ST). In this paper, we look at the various methods that can be employed to ensure your seamless conversion of speech to text, primarily focusing on its use for police functioning . We are going to focus on the CTC+Attention model, End-to-end Speech Translation (ST) models, a Speech Recognition model developed using Google Speech Recognition model, PCM A-law codecs and also Voice Recognition Module V3<sup>[12]</sup>. We’ll also be observing different techniques and algorithms which can be applied to achieve the required functionalities.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Similarity Measure for Feature based 3D-2D Registration in Vertebral Pose Estimation
abstract: The vertebral pose estimation helps to assist the clinician during the surgery to avoid the wrong site surgery. The vertebral poses are estimated by establishing the spatial correspondence relationship between the pre-operative MR image and intra-operative X-ray, and then assessed by a similarity measure. Many similarity measure techniques such as mutual Information, normalized cross-correlation, etc., were used in 3D to 2D registration techniques. So the proposed framework employs three different similarity measures: Binary Image Matching, Dice Coefficients, and Normalized Cross-correlation technique to compare the images based on pixel positions to evaluate the registration performance. In the absence of Intra-operative X-ray images, the experiment is conducted on the simulated test images. Registration accuracy is estimated based on the mean Target Registration Error. The results demonstrated that the three similarity measures work well for feature-based 3D to 2D registration in that the Dice coefficient gives the best result.

articleTitle: Lung Carcinoma Diagnosis and Classification using Deep Learning
abstract: The proposed work implements the modified Inception Recurrent RCNN algorithm for Lung Carcinoma detection using segmentation and deep learning with a lesser number of epochs. Histopathological Images of the Lung Carcinoma dataset were used for training, testing, and validation. The model’s performance was tested under two conditions, first with a reduced number of input images and second with a reduced number of iterations to reduce the processing time for image diagnosis without compromising Accuracy and Precision. High performance is achieved with Inception Recurrent RCNN when applied to lung carcinoma classification against object classification and breast cancer classification.

articleTitle: Stability Analysis of EV Aggregated Load Frequency Control System using LKF Approach
abstract: This paper deals with the stability analysis of load frequency control (LFC) system with the involvement of electric vehicle aggregator (EVA). Time-varying delay arises from the open communication networks such as the Internet, WiFi and so on which are used to convey the control signal to electric vehicles. The stability of the network frequency is severely impacted by time delays. So, the stability analysis of load frequency control system taking EVA into account is done using Linear Matrix Inequality (LMI) framework. In this study, asymptotic stability of the system is ensured by making use of the Lyapunov Krasovskii Functional (LKF) technique coupled with free matrix approach combined with Jensen integral inequality.

articleTitle: Frequency Based Pest Detection User Interface using Neural Networks
abstract: This paper discusses a method to detect a pest in the agricultural field. The principle concept used here is, processing audio signals produced by the pests and comparing them to a predefined database. The setup includes a microphone which captures the different sounds produced by pests. The detected pest is conveyed to the user with the help of a mobile application which is connected to the microcontroller. The received data is captured for further enhancement in the cloud storage. This data can be accessed through the mobile application. Machine learning algorithms are used to classify the pests.

articleTitle: Resistive Readout Circuit for Chemiresistive Sensor Interfacing with Android Application
abstract: Heavy metals are toxic, have a higher atomic weight, and harm living things in the long run. They cause water pollution through municipal and industrial waste mixed with river water. ICP-OES AAS and ICP-MS are currently available approaches for detecting heavy metal ions (HMI). These current methods require skilled personnel and lengthy sample preparation. Moreover, these techniques are complicated, expensive, and non-portable.In addition, capacitive and electrochemical sensors are frequency-dependent. Therefore, chemiresistive sensors are preferable as this method is frequency independent and portable. A chemiresistive sensor's resistance varies with the concentration of heavy metal ions detected. This paper describes a resistive readout circuit for measuring the dynamic resistance of a chemiresistive sensor. The circuit measures the resistance in the low range (10 Ω to 1 KΩ) and the high range (up to 10KΩ) and displays the measured resistance on an OLED. The designed readout circuit measured dynamic resistance chemiresistive with less than 1.5 % error. An Android application developed with Android Studio connects the readout circuit wirelessly via the HC-05 Bluetooth module to display the resistance on the application's serial monitor. This simple readout circuit can measure the resistance of a fast-changing sensor with a minor error.

articleTitle: New Born Baby Cry Analysis and Classification
abstract: This study proposes a baby cry detection system using Mel Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) and K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) algorithm. The review of a wide variety of literature focuses primarily on data gathering, processing of signals in cross domain, and classification using machine learning algorithms. When using various apps to monitor a baby’s condition, automatic voice detection of a baby’s cry is crucial. This hypothesized concept involves the detection of a baby’s scream. To distinguish infant sounds of crying in a range of settings which are residential under challenging circumstances, this system uses a machine learning technique. The proposed method extracts MFCC features from the audio signals of the baby cries and applies KNN to classify the cries based on their features. The results are based on a classification-related investigation of the performance of cry-detection using KNN. A baby’s cry may be automatically detected in a few circumstances including different environmental noises. The suggested technique demonstrated high accuracy in identifying cry types when tested using a freely accessible dataset.

articleTitle: FPGA implementation of Parameterizable Pattern-generator Modules for LBIST applications
abstract: In this paper, a parameterizable Linear Feedback Shift Register design for LBIST applications is designed and implemented in Basys-3 FPGA board using Xilinx Vivado Suite 2020.1. The LFSR mainly helps us in pseudorandom test vector generation which can be used in Pseudo Random Pattern Generator (PRPG) and Multiple Input Signature Register (MISR) units for Logic Built In Self-Test (LBIST) applications. Increasing complexity and usage of Integrated Chips in military, medical, automobile and satellite devices has paved in the way for industries to look into LBIST based on-site chip testing instead of old traditional ATE based testing where the device had to be taken to ATE based test centres for probing, testing and validations. The design proposed in this paper can be reconfigured into multiple configurations like internal, external and complete configurations. Proposed design can also be programmed into multiple polynomial configurations based on intended application. Reconfigurable LFSR configuration features also integrated in the proposed design helping users to test the majority of the random pattern resistant faults present in the circuit while utilising the LFSR to create more sequences without increasing storage needs. The proposed design can generate multiple range of bits based on its intended applications.

articleTitle: Electric Vehicle Charging Station Design for V2G and G2V Operation
abstract: Nowadays the adoption of large number of electrical vehicles (EV’s) will considerably reduce the emission and appear to be the best replacement for IC engine vehicles. Thus, the requirement of charging station is very important due to the increasing number of EV’s. These EV charging stations are operated in connection to the grid, will also increase the requirement of more power supply from the grid. The increasing requirement of power will lead to the increase in the load on the distribution grid. The proposed electrical vehicle charging station can perform the vehicle-to-grid (V2G) and grid-to-vehicle mode of operation and fast DC charging for multiple EV’s. In proposed charging station, the EV’s are integrated to the DC bus through the individual control system for separate power transfer from the AC grid through the DC bus. The proposed model is simulated to demonstrate the charging (G2V) and discharging (V2G) behavior of the electric vehicle in grid connected mode. The simulation result shows the effectiveness of the proposed model for the V2G and G2V operation.

articleTitle: Power Saving in Multi-Hop Device to Device Communication
abstract: In this paper a method has been proposed to save power in multi-hop Device to Device communication. D2D [1] communication provides a lot of advantages like increase in spectral efficiency and improve throughput. In multi-hop D2D [1] communication there are multiple hops present in the path from source device to destination device. The routing path in our proposal is decided at every hop on the basis of the signal strength, bandwidth and access technology. A feedback mechanism is also provided which will provide feedback to the previous hop about real power consumption and Radio Access Technology. The idea provides a mechanism to user by which he can control the maximum power or total power consumption for whole transaction and each device makes its own decision based on its supported access technology and power control command received from source device to transmit the data to destination. The device which is the originator of the D2D [1] communication can send information and the commands for power consumption which it and next devices in hope can use for this transaction. Hence smartly choosing most desirable hop and access technology at every level of the routing path can help in saving Power.

articleTitle: A Low-Profile Microstrip-Fed Monopole Antenna with Frequency Selective Surface for C band Satellite Applications
abstract: This paper proposes a low profile microstrip-fed circular ring monopole antenna with frequency selective surface (FSS) to achieve high gain and directivity. The FSS unit cell is designed using a square loop with inductive loaded T-shape patch which operates in the extended C-band. The proposed antenna has a dimension of 28×30×1.6 mm3 which is designed on an FR4 substrate and the FSS unit cell size is 7×8×1.6 mm3. The effects of antenna parameters on its performance have been examined through parametric analysis and optimized dimensions are realized. The results demonstrate that the antenna provides improvement in gain and directivity of 2.74 dB and 1.40 dB, respectively over the frequency range of 3.7–4.2 GHz. The low profile, simple geometry and descent gain are the key features of the design and may be a good candidate for satellite down link communication.

articleTitle: Planetary Structures Detection and Segmentation Using Deep Learning
abstract: Detecting geological structures on other planets can help in exploring fascinating features and understand the geological significance of the structures, factors such as age and the planet’s geological history. There does not exist one single algorithm that works for all the prominent structures. Hence, this paper aims to implement and test various deep learning algorithms based on CNN to accurately predict and classify the input images to respective planetary structures. The agenda is to formulate a standardized algorithm for classifying all the planetary structures.

articleTitle: A Decentralized Mail Using Blockchain
abstract: Currently, email services have become a global standard for official communication and conducting business negotiations. Traditional email systems rely on centralized servers to provide their services. The attacking central server sends confidential messages and personal information to the attacker. To that end, this white paper uses blockchain technology which uses Proof-of-Work and Proof-of-Stack consensus mechanisms to create a decentralized email system with trust, accountability, and scalability.

articleTitle: A Unique Approach towards Serial Parallel Multiplier to Reduce Number of Components
abstract: In this paper a creative and modified design of serial parallel Multipliers (SPM) has been proposed. The circuit architecture of the existing serial parallel multiplier has been modified to reduce the resource constraints and also to improvise on area, power and delay. The proposed SPM architecture reduces the complexity of existing architecture i.e by reducing number of blocks of implementation. The existing SPM and proposed SPM both are realised using verilog code and tested in Quartus 18.1 environment. It shows improvement in consumption of resources, area and power. Further the proposed architecture can be extended for optimisation of latency and delay constraints. The test was carried out for both 4 bit and 8 bit SPM architecture design. In comparison with existing architectures the proposed method shows 18.5% reduction in consumption of resources. The proposed architecture can find utmost applications in various domains where digital multiplication is critical.

articleTitle: Research on Application of English Learning App based on Android Platform
abstract: English learning application based on Android platform is one of the best ways to learn English. This is a good tool for those who are interested in learning English. With this application, you can have fun learning English. This application is designed for everyone. No matter what their age or gender, it is easy to learn English through this application. Android means it is an operating system that runs on mobile devices such as smartphones and tablets. This study aims to develop an Android platform application to help students learn English. The main purpose of this study is to analyze and evaluate the effectiveness of the application in improving students' English language skills. This application will be developed using Android SDK version 4.0 (API level 15), with a minimum requirement of 1 GB ram and 512 MB storage space. The touch screen device runs on Android 2.2 or later, and Java 5 or later installed on the computer.

articleTitle: Deep CNN: Classification of Known Classes and Unknown Classes Based on Softmax Prediction Probabilities
abstract: Detecting unknown classes in an image classification is one of the key challenges deep learning developers confront. The idea of image recognition is built on deep learning, which can process enormous amounts of unstructured data by initializing weights and biases in neural networks with random values. By using Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) algorithm it is possible to identify between known classes (labeled data) and unknown class with open-set classification. The datasets Flavia Leaf Dataset and Swedish Leaf Dataset are considered for training and datasets that are not a part of training set are also considered for testing. The number of accurate and inaccurate predictions for each class is calculated using the confusion matrix for each class along with performance indicators such as accuracy.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of Nano Satellite data receiver using SDR
abstract: Satellites weighing less than 10kilograms are named as nano satellites [1]. In the last decade nano satellites has become the main focus in the area of space research activities. For communication most of the nano satellites transmits telemetry or payload signal in UHF band frequencies. Now a days nano satellites are launched by government space agencies, private space sector companies and educational institution for carrying out special activities or research.On the other hand, software define radio is another advancement in the field of telecommunication, wherein a wide range of signal frequency can be tuned, recorded and processed to get the data from the satellites all using software. In this paper design and complete implementation of Nano satellite data receiver using software defined radio is presented and data processing techniques are discussed in details. The paper also discusses the importance of choosing sampling rates while recording RF signal and further the baseband processing.

articleTitle: Anonymous Decentralized Chat Engine Over Overlay Networks
abstract: Chatting privately without having trust in a third party is a challenge and has not been addressed completely in the literature. In this context, we explore an existing concept of having an overlay network on an overlay network. This helps one overlay network inherit strengths and maybe also weaknesses from the host overlay network. In this paper, we explore a decentralized anonymous file system that can help someone talk privately with anyone he/she wishes. We propose a technological solution AnonFS that runs over an anonymous overlay network such as Tor and I2P. With the use of Tor or I2P, AnonFS inherits the property of Anonymity of connection. AnonFS is zero-trust cloud storage for synchronization. One can share content or even synchronize with multiple devices using AnonFS. AnonChat works by initiating a direct connection from one Tor/I2P peer to another Tor/I2P peer. AnonChat uses AnonFS to store and retrieve data anonymously. The identity of the user is never tied to any physical entity such as email ID, phone number, IP address, or any other personally identifiable information. This means that if the user is really careful about whom he shares the information with, AnonChat can be completely untraceable. We qualitatively compare AnonFS with several popular services.

articleTitle: Morphed Face Image Detection Using PCA and Binary Classification
abstract: Every day, technology advances. The advancement of security technology raises a number of concerns. One of the major challenges of this method is face detection. Biometrics are used to detect faces by measuring the length of the eyes or the distance of features, but it can be difficult to determine if the face is original. As a result, many authors have recently proposed various techniques to address this issue. As a result, these models suffer a number of flaws, the most significant of which is the amount of time required. PCA (principal component analysis) and a binary classifier are used in the proposed model construction to speed up modeling and boost effectiveness.
